# Leap Studio — Creative Agency Landing Page

## Overview

Build a single-page dark-mode website for **Leap Studio**, a global creative agency positioning itself as a reinvention and experience partner for enterprise clients. The site must feel **bold, modern, and elegant** — think high-end design studio meets tech-forward consultancy. The audience is brand leaders and innovation teams at large organizations, so every pixel should communicate confidence, sophistication, and global scale.

## Visual Direction

- **Dark mode is the default and only mode.** Use a near-black background (#0A0A0A or similar) with crisp white typography and selective accent colors — think electric blue or warm amber for interactive highlights.
- **Typography:** Use a modern sans-serif (Inter, Neue Haas Grotesk, or similar). Hero headlines should be large and commanding; body text clean and readable against dark backgrounds.
- **Imagery:** Use placeholder images with muted, cinematic tones. Project cards and team photos should feel editorial.
- **Spacing:** Generous whitespace. Let sections breathe — this is a premium brand.

## Key Priorities

1. **The region-toggle team carousel is the most complex interaction.** Four region tabs (North America, Asia, Europe, Oceania) must filter team member cards, each showing a photo, quote, title, and office location. Get this right — it demonstrates the agency's global footprint.
2. **The hero carousel** sets the tone for the entire page. Transitions should feel smooth and intentional, cycling through featured content cards.
3. **Work showcase** — the horizontal-scrolling project cards are a core selling point. Each case study needs a strong visual thumbnail paired with its title.
4. **The language selector dropdown** and **cookie consent banner** are smaller but must function correctly as toggles.
5. **Responsive design is mandatory.** Carousels should adapt gracefully to mobile (swipe-friendly), and the navigation should collapse appropriately.

Refer to `task_input.json` for the full section order, all interaction definitions, data content, and navigation structure.

---

## Data Sources

1. Read `/app/benchmark/source_brief.md` for all content materials (text, data).
2. Read `/app/benchmark/task_input.json` for structural requirements, data placement, and interaction definitions.

## Output Requirements

1. Output all files to `/app/output/`. `index.html` must be the main entry point.
2. All pages must be openable directly in a browser (no build step needed). Use relative paths for inter-page links.

## Automated Execution Rules

There is no human operator online for this session. Follow these rules:

1. **Skip all confirmation/approval/user-input steps** — make professional judgments autonomously. Do not pause, ask questions, or wait for replies.
2. **Design decisions** — if `task_input.json` specifies `site.tone`, `site.audience`, etc., use them to choose styles, layouts, and color schemes. Otherwise, make professional judgments.
3. **Priority** — these rules override any interactive-wait instructions in SKILL.md. The skill's workflow, quality standards, and technical specs remain fully effective — only skip interactive waits.

1	# Leap Studio — Your Reinvention and Experience Partner
2	
3	## Brand
4	Leap Studio is a global creative agency that challenges the status quo to create transformative experiences that win hearts and move markets in the eco-digital era. Part of Meridian Consulting Group, Leap Studio fuses design, strategy, and technology across 30+ studios worldwide to help enterprise clients navigate the dual transition of sustainability and digital innovation.
5	
6	Brand colors: #000000 (primary black), #FFFFFF (white), #808080 (neutral gray)
7	
8	Dark mode: Yes (default). Typography: bold, modern, elegant. Tone: confident and visionary.
9	
10	## Hero Content
11	The hero is a multi-slide carousel featuring rotating content cards:
12	
13	- **Slide 1 — Futurescape: Synthetic Realities** — "Welcome to the Futurescape. Discover trends and insights on the future of human-AI chemistry." CTA: "Read the report"
14	- **Slide 2 — Designing Robots for Human Spaces** — "Meet 'Aura,' a concept from Leap Studio that offers a human-centered approach to physical AI." CTA: "Explore the work"
15	- **Slide 3 — Amplifying Clinical Care with AI** — "Examining how service design helps experts understand the healthcare ecosystem." CTA: "Explore now"
16	- **Slide 4 — Design Mind Leapcast Ep. 55** — "Peter Hallström, Global Head of Design at Lumina Health, discusses the evolution of product design and the role of design leadership." CTA: "Listen now"
17	- **Slide 5 — From Complexity to Clarity** — "Dive into new research on how CMOs can reclaim marketing to build competitive edge." CTA: "Read the report"
18	
19	## Global Studios
20	Section title: "Welcome to the studio"
21	Subtitle: "Meet the team making an impact for leading brands around the globe."
22	
23	Region tabs: **North America** · **Asia** · **Europe** · **Oceania**
24	
25	| Name | Title | Office | Quote |
26	|------|-------|--------|-------|
27	| Denice Alvarez | Office Manager | New York | "As the Office Manager, I engage with teams from every discipline, and have learned so much through my day-to-day interactions with my fellow leapers." |
28	| Marco Bellini | Design Director | San Francisco | "Every day we are delighted by the immense beauty that nature holds. When engaged in the act of creation, it is our responsibility to channel that delight into the things we make." |
29	| Priya Mehta | Studio Head | Bangalore | "We bring your brand vision to life, with transformative ideas and impactful marketing campaigns fueled by creativity and enthusiasm." |
30	| Thierry Lam | Design Lead | Singapore | "Good design is multifaceted. It impacts functionality, aesthetics, strategy, environment, business and so much more. Great design is seamless." |
31	| Gavin Hartley | Managing Director | London | "It's my job to make sure we innovate and push the boundaries when collaborating with brands to create inspiring customer experiences that deliver great business results." |
32	| Francesca Terzi | Design Director | Munich | "At Leap Studio, I am constantly amazed by the talent I am surrounded with. We love to dream big and bring those dreams to life." |
33	| Jacintha Soo Ho | Senior Manager, CX Transformation | Melbourne | "I love helping clients see beyond their assumptions and showing them opportunities they haven't thought of before." |
34	
35	Each card includes a CTA: "Contact Leap Studio [City]"
36	
37	## Client Work
38	Section title: "Our work"
39	Subtitle: "Reinvent your business and realize exceptional experiences that win hearts and move markets."
40	
41	Featured projects:
42	
43	1. **Unilever — Creating Consumer Insights at Scale** — "The PDC provides insight not only to marketing, but also to supply chain, R&D, HR and finance. Thanks to the collaboration with Leap Studio we now have the capability to provide insight and action all across the organisation." — Alex Owens, VP, Global Head of People Data Centres, Unilever
44	2. **IKEA Retail (Ingka Group) — Deepening Customer Engagement**
45	3. **Volvo Group — Harnessing Data for Leaner and Greener Future of Mobility**
46	4. **Chase Payment Solutions — Modernizing the Point-of-Sale Experience**
47	5. **Tiffany & Co. — Reimagining Luxury Craftsmanship** — "We valued the truly collaborative process from conception to delivery. The resulting experience beautifully emphasizes our core brand codes of craftsmanship and heritage, while effectively leveraging new AI technologies." — Thomas Arnold, Digital Experience Design & Innovation Director
48	6. **Majid Al Futtaim / Carrefour — Helping Healthier Habits Stick** — "Our 'Pick Your 5' framework, based on your behavior change strategy, is going to be instrumental in driving positive outcomes." — Sheila Chaiban, Global CMO
49	
50	Additional projects: Designing Robots for Human Spaces · Harboring Culture Year-Round (Destination NSW)
51	
52	## CTA Banner
53	Title: "Let's work together"
54	Body: "Reach out to our global team to imagine, make and scale new products, services, experiences, business models, ventures and ways of working."
55	CTA: "Get in touch"
56	
57	## How We Work
58	Headline: **Advancing people and planet**
59	Body: "The disruptive forces of emerging technologies and sustainable objectives present a reinvention imperative for businesses—and the potential to create entirely new dimensions of value. Navigate the dual transition of the eco-digital era with innovative solutions to today's biggest challenges."
60	CTA: "Explore our services"
61	
62	## Latest Insights
63	Section title: "Latest insights"
64	Subtitle: "Explore research, provocations and perspectives on trends across technology, creativity, business and culture."
65	
66	| Type | Title | CTA |
67	|------|-------|-----|
68	| Podcast | Ep. 58 — When Human Connection Meets AI | Listen |
69	| Podcast | Ep. 57 — Writing the Future of AI | Listen |
70	| Article | Amplifying Clinical Care with AI | Read |
71	| Podcast | Ep. 56 — The Future of Customer Experience | Listen |
72	| Article | Next-Gen Contact Centers: Powered by AI | Read |
73	| Article | The AI-Empowered Marketer | Read |
74	| Podcast | Ep. 55 — What Makes a Product Great? | Listen |
75	| Insight Report | From Complexity to Clarity | Download |
76	
77	## Our Principles
78	
79	1. **Challenge the status quo** — From launching game-changing products and services to redefining business as usual, our work bridges the gap between what could be and what should be.
80	2. **Fuse art & science to make ideas real** — We innovate with equal parts expertise in creativity and transformation, leveraging next-level data and tech to elevate experiences for all.
81	3. **Create a lasting impact at global scale** — Driving meaningful outcomes starts with reimagining systems at a fundamental level. As part of Meridian Consulting, we bring a global reach and diverse skillsets to our approach.
82	4. **Regenerate systems & communities** — In the eco-digital era, we believe every collaboration is an opportunity to create social, economic and environmental value for all.
83	
84	## Navigation
85	Primary: Insights · Work · Services · Culture · Make Your Mark · Contact Us
86	Language selector: Global EN · France FR · China CN
87	
88	## Footer
89	CTA 1: "Ready to make your mark? As your reinvention and experience partner, our global team is here to help." → "Get in touch"
90	CTA 2: "Do your best work among a caring community of diverse talents." → "Join our team"
91

# Leap Studio — Your Reinvention and Experience Partner

## Brand
Leap Studio is a global creative agency that challenges the status quo to create transformative experiences that win hearts and move markets in the eco-digital era. Part of Meridian Consulting Group, Leap Studio fuses design, strategy, and technology across 30+ studios worldwide to help enterprise clients navigate the dual transition of sustainability and digital innovation.

Brand colors: #000000 (primary black), #FFFFFF (white), #808080 (neutral gray)

Dark mode: Yes (default). Typography: bold, modern, elegant. Tone: confident and visionary.

## Hero Content
The hero is a multi-slide carousel featuring rotating content cards:

- **Slide 1 — Futurescape: Synthetic Realities** — "Welcome to the Futurescape. Discover trends and insights on the future of human-AI chemistry." CTA: "Read the report"
- **Slide 2 — Designing Robots for Human Spaces** — "Meet 'Aura,' a concept from Leap Studio that offers a human-centered approach to physical AI." CTA: "Explore the work"
- **Slide 3 — Amplifying Clinical Care with AI** — "Examining how service design helps experts understand the healthcare ecosystem." CTA: "Explore now"
- **Slide 4 — Design Mind Leapcast Ep. 55** — "Peter Hallström, Global Head of Design at Lumina Health, discusses the evolution of product design and the role of design leadership." CTA: "Listen now"
- **Slide 5 — From Complexity to Clarity** — "Dive into new research on how CMOs can reclaim marketing to build competitive edge." CTA: "Read the report"

## Global Studios
Section title: "Welcome to the studio"
Subtitle: "Meet the team making an impact for leading brands around the globe."

Region tabs: **North America** · **Asia** · **Europe** · **Oceania**

| Name | Title | Office | Quote |
|------|-------|--------|-------|
| Denice Alvarez | Office Manager | New York | "As the Office Manager, I engage with teams from every discipline, and have learned so much through my day-to-day interactions with my fellow leapers." |
| Marco Bellini | Design Director | San Francisco | "Every day we are delighted by the immense beauty that nature holds. When engaged in the act of creation, it is our responsibility to channel that delight into the things we make." |
| Priya Mehta | Studio Head | Bangalore | "We bring your brand vision to life, with transformative ideas and impactful marketing campaigns fueled by creativity and enthusiasm." |
| Thierry Lam | Design Lead | Singapore | "Good design is multifaceted. It impacts functionality, aesthetics, strategy, environment, business and so much more. Great design is seamless." |
| Gavin Hartley | Managing Director | London | "It's my job to make sure we innovate and push the boundaries when collaborating with brands to create inspiring customer experiences that deliver great business results." |
| Francesca Terzi | Design Director | Munich | "At Leap Studio, I am constantly amazed by the talent I am surrounded with. We love to dream big and bring those dreams to life." |
| Jacintha Soo Ho | Senior Manager, CX Transformation | Melbourne | "I love helping clients see beyond their assumptions and showing them opportunities they haven't thought of before." |

Each card includes a CTA: "Contact Leap Studio [City]"

## Client Work
Section title: "Our work"
Subtitle: "Reinvent your business and realize exceptional experiences that win hearts and move markets."

Featured projects:

1. **Unilever — Creating Consumer Insights at Scale** — "The PDC provides insight not only to marketing, but also to supply chain, R&D, HR and finance. Thanks to the collaboration with Leap Studio we now have the capability to provide insight and action all across the organisation." — Alex Owens, VP, Global Head of People Data Centres, Unilever
2. **IKEA Retail (Ingka Group) — Deepening Customer Engagement**
3. **Volvo Group — Harnessing Data for Leaner and Greener Future of Mobility**
4. **Chase Payment Solutions — Modernizing the Point-of-Sale Experience**
5. **Tiffany & Co. — Reimagining Luxury Craftsmanship** — "We valued the truly collaborative process from conception to delivery. The resulting experience beautifully emphasizes our core brand codes of craftsmanship and heritage, while effectively leveraging new AI technologies." — Thomas Arnold, Digital Experience Design & Innovation Director
6. **Majid Al Futtaim / Carrefour — Helping Healthier Habits Stick** — "Our 'Pick Your 5' framework, based on your behavior change strategy, is going to be instrumental in driving positive outcomes." — Sheila Chaiban, Global CMO

Additional projects: Designing Robots for Human Spaces · Harboring Culture Year-Round (Destination NSW)

## CTA Banner
Title: "Let's work together"
Body: "Reach out to our global team to imagine, make and scale new products, services, experiences, business models, ventures and ways of working."
CTA: "Get in touch"

## How We Work
Headline: **Advancing people and planet**
Body: "The disruptive forces of emerging technologies and sustainable objectives present a reinvention imperative for businesses—and the potential to create entirely new dimensions of value. Navigate the dual transition of the eco-digital era with innovative solutions to today's biggest challenges."
CTA: "Explore our services"

## Latest Insights
Section title: "Latest insights"
Subtitle: "Explore research, provocations and perspectives on trends across technology, creativity, business and culture."

| Type | Title | CTA |
|------|-------|-----|
| Podcast | Ep. 58 — When Human Connection Meets AI | Listen |
| Podcast | Ep. 57 — Writing the Future of AI | Listen |
| Article | Amplifying Clinical Care with AI | Read |
| Podcast | Ep. 56 — The Future of Customer Experience | Listen |
| Article | Next-Gen Contact Centers: Powered by AI | Read |
| Article | The AI-Empowered Marketer | Read |
| Podcast | Ep. 55 — What Makes a Product Great? | Listen |
| Insight Report | From Complexity to Clarity | Download |

## Our Principles

1. **Challenge the status quo** — From launching game-changing products and services to redefining business as usual, our work bridges the gap between what could be and what should be.
2. **Fuse art & science to make ideas real** — We innovate with equal parts expertise in creativity and transformation, leveraging next-level data and tech to elevate experiences for all.
3. **Create a lasting impact at global scale** — Driving meaningful outcomes starts with reimagining systems at a fundamental level. As part of Meridian Consulting, we bring a global reach and diverse skillsets to our approach.
4. **Regenerate systems & communities** — In the eco-digital era, we believe every collaboration is an opportunity to create social, economic and environmental value for all.

## Navigation
Primary: Insights · Work · Services · Culture · Make Your Mark · Contact Us
Language selector: Global EN · France FR · China CN

## Footer
CTA 1: "Ready to make your mark? As your reinvention and experience partner, our global team is here to help." → "Get in touch"
CTA 2: "Do your best work among a caring community of diverse talents." → "Join our team"

Links: Studios · Culture · DE&I · Play

{"type": "text", "text": "Base directory for this skill: /logs/agent/sessions/skills/web-design-expert

# Web Design Expert

Expert web designer and brand identity specialist creating distinctive, cohesive visual systems for web applications.

## When to Use This Skill

**Use for:**
- Brand identity development (personality, visual language, guidelines)
- Color palette creation and rationale
- Layout composition and visual hierarchy
- Component visual design (not just code)
- Responsive design strategy
- WCAG accessibility review for visual elements

**Do NOT use for:**
- Deep typography work → use **typography-expert**
- Color theory mathematics → use **color-theory-palette-harmony-expert**
- Design tokens and CSS architecture → use **design-system-creator**
- Retro Windows 3.1 → use **windows-3-1-web-designer**
- Native app design → use **native-app-designer**

## Core Design Process

### 1. Discovery (Critical First Step)

```
BUSINESS CONTEXT:
- What is the primary goal?
- Who is the target audience?
- What action should users take?
- Who are competitors?

BRAND PERSONALITY:
- If this brand were a person, how would they dress?
- Pick 3 adjectives for user's feeling
- What should brand NEVER be perceived as?
```

### 2. Visual Direction (Provide 2-3 Concepts)

Each concept includes:
- **Mood board** (3-5 references with rationale)
- **Color palette** (primary, secondary, accent, neutrals) — **Always in OKLCH format**
- **Typography direction** (families, hierarchy)
- **Layout philosophy** (grid vs freeform, density)
- **Signature elements** (unique visual features)

## OKLCH: The Modern Color Standard

**⚠️ All color palettes must use OKLCH, not hex or HSL.**

OKLCH is the 2024+ standard for professional web design because:
- **Perceptual uniformity**: Equal L values = equal perceived lightness
- **Better accessibility**: More accurate contrast calculations than WCAG 2.x hex
- **Predictable scaling**: Math works (L=50% + 20% = L=70% that looks right)

```css
/* OKLCH format: oklch(Lightness% Chroma Hue) */
--brand-primary: oklch(55% 0.22 265);    /* Vibrant blue */
--brand-accent: oklch(75% 0.18 45);      /* Warm orange */
--text-primary: oklch(20% 0.02 265);     /* Near-black */
--bg-surface: oklch(98% 0.01 265);       /* Near-white */
```

**Essential OKLCH Resources:**
| Resource | Purpose |
|----------|---------|
| [oklch.com](https://oklch.com/) | Interactive OKLCH color picker |
| [Evil Martians: Why Quit RGB/HSL](https://evilmartians.com/chronicles/oklch-in-css-why-quit-rgb-hsl) | The definitive article |
| [Harmonizer](https://harmonizer.evilmartians.com/) | Generate harmonious OKLCH palettes |

**When presenting color palettes:**
```
Primary: oklch(55% 0.22 265) — Vibrant blue, strong CTA presence
Secondary: oklch(70% 0.08 265) — Muted blue, supporting elements
Accent: oklch(75% 0.18 45) — Warm orange, attention-grabbing
```

Never present palettes as `#3b82f6` — always convert to OKLCH.

### 3. Design Principles

**Hierarchy**: Most important element immediately obvious? Eye flows naturally?

**Consistency**: Same colors mean same things? Spacing follows scale?

## Common Anti-Patterns

### Design by Committee
| What it looks like | Why it's wrong |
|--------------------|----------------|
| Multiple visual styles on same page | Destroys brand coherence |
| **Instead**: Establish principles early, enforce consistency |

### Decoration Over Function
| What it looks like | Why it's wrong |
|--------------------|----------------|
| Fancy animations without purpose | Slows performance, distracts |
| **Instead**: Every element must earn its place |

### Ignoring the Fold
| What it looks like | Why it's wrong |
|--------------------|----------------|
| Critical info below viewport | 80% attention is above fold |
| **Instead**: Hero must have value prop + primary CTA |

### Low Contrast Text
| What it looks like | Why it's wrong |
|--------------------|----------------|
| Light gray on white (#999 on #fff) | Fails WCAG, excludes users |
| **Instead**: Minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio |

### Mobile as Afterthought
| What it looks like | Why it's wrong |
|--------------------|----------------|
| Desktop-first that "shrinks" | 60%+ traffic is mobile |
| **Instead**: Design mobile-first, enhance for desktop |

## Design Trend Evolution

| Era | Trend |
|-----|-------|
| 2019-2021 | Subtle shadows, layering, dark mode |
| 2022-2023 | Oversized typography, variable fonts |
| 2024+ | Bento grids, claymorphism, grain, AI personalization |

**Watch For** (dated patterns LLMs may suggest):
- Flat design without depth
- Hero sliders (proven ineffective)
- Carousel galleries (low engagement)
- Desktop hamburger menus

## Output Deliverables

1. **Brand Identity Guide**: Colors, typography, voice, do's/don'ts
2. **Design Specifications**: Spacing, radius, shadows, animation timing
3. **Component Examples**: Buttons, forms, cards, navigation (all states)
4. **Responsive Guidelines**: Breakpoints, layout changes, touch targets

## MCP Tools

| Tool | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `21st_magic_component_inspiration` | Search UI patterns for inspiration |
| `21st_magic_component_builder` | Generate React/Tailwind components |
| `21st_magic_component_refiner` | Improve existing component UI |
| `logo_search` | Get company logos in JSX/TSX/SVG |

## Integration with Other Skills

Paired skills are bundled at `paired-skills/` in this skill directory. Read the corresponding SKILL.md when you need deeper expertise:

# Layout Systems

Grid systems, spacing scales, and layout composition.

## Grid Decision Tree

```
IF content-heavy (blog, documentation, dashboard)
  → 12-column grid, consistent gutters

IF marketing/landing page
  → Flexible sections, asymmetric allowed, dramatic whitespace

IF e-commerce/catalog
  → CSS Grid auto-fit for responsive product grids

IF editorial/magazine
  → Mixed grid, large images, pull quotes, visual variety

IF app interface
  → Sidebar + main content, dense but organized
```

## Spacing Scale (8px Base)

```css
--space-1: 4px;   /* Tight: icon padding, inline elements */
--space-2: 8px;   /* Compact: form field padding */
--space-3: 16px;  /* Default: card padding, element gaps */
--space-4: 24px;  /* Comfortable: section gaps */
--space-5: 32px;  /* Generous: major section breaks */
--space-6: 48px;  /* Dramatic: hero margins */
--space-7: 64px;  /* Statement: page sections */
--space-8: 96px;  /* Massive: landing page breaks */
```

## Responsive Breakpoints

```css
/* Content-based breakpoints, not device-based */
/* Start mobile-first, add complexity as viewport grows */

/* Base: Mobile */
.container { padding: 16px; }

/* 640px: Content needs more room */
@media (min-width: 640px) {
  .container { max-width: 640px; padding: 24px; }
}

/* 1024px: Multi-column becomes useful */
@media (min-width: 1024px) {
  .container { max-width: 1024px; }
  .grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
}

/* 1280px: Maximum content width reached */
@media (min-width: 1280px) {
  .container { max-width: 1200px; }
  .grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
}
```

## Mobile-First Checklist

```
□ Touch targets minimum 44x44px
□ No hover-only interactions
□ Text readable without zooming (16px+ base)
□ Forms have appropriate input types (email, tel, date)
□ Images lazy-loaded and responsive
□ Navigation collapses to hamburger or bottom nav
□ Critical actions visible without scrolling
```

## Visual Hierarchy Checklist

```
□ Is the most important element immediately obvious?
□ Can users scan the page in 3 seconds and understand purpose?
□ Does the eye flow naturally from primary → secondary → tertiary?
□ Are clickable elements obviously clickable?
□ Is there a clear visual distinction between content types?
```

## Consistency Checklist

```
□ Same colors mean same things throughout?
□ Spacing follows a consistent scale?
□ Typography uses no more than 3 sizes/weights per page?
□ Interactive states (hover, focus, active) are predictable?
□ Icons follow same style (line weight, fill, size)?
```

# Color & Accessibility

Color palettes, psychology, dark mode, and WCAG compliance.

## Minimum Viable Palette

```
PRIMARY: Main brand color (CTAs, key elements)
SECONDARY: Supporting color (headers, accents)
NEUTRAL DARK: Text, borders (#1a1a1a to #333)
NEUTRAL MID: Secondary text, disabled (#666 to #999)
NEUTRAL LIGHT: Backgrounds, cards (#f5f5f5 to #fafafa)
ACCENT: Success/error/warning (semantic colors)
```

## Color Psychology Quick Reference

| Color | Conveys | Use For |
|-------|---------|---------|
| Blue | Trust, stability, professional | Finance, healthcare, enterprise |
| Green | Growth, nature, success | Wellness, finance, sustainability |
| Red | Energy, urgency, passion | Food, entertainment, errors |
| Orange | Friendly, confident, creative | Startups, creative agencies |
| Purple | Luxury, wisdom, creativity | Beauty, education, premium |
| Yellow | Optimism, warmth, caution | Warnings, highlights (use sparingly) |
| Black | Sophistication, power, luxury | Fashion, luxury, minimalism |

## Dark Mode Guidelines

**DO:**
- Reduce brightness of images (filter: brightness(0.85))
- Use dark grays (#121212) not pure black (#000)
- Increase contrast for text (bump from 400 to 450 weight)
- Reduce shadow intensity

**DON'T:**
- Simply invert colors (looks jarring)
- Keep same accent color saturation (lower by 10-20%)
- Forget to test colored text on dark backgrounds

## WCAG 2.1 AA Visual Checklist

```
□ Color contrast 4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for large text
□ Information not conveyed by color alone
□ Focus indicators visible (don't remove outline)
□ Animations can be paused/reduced (prefers-reduced-motion)
□ Text resizable to 200% without breaking layout
□ Touch targets 44x44px minimum
□ Error states clearly indicated (not just red)
```

## Focus State Template

```css
:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

/* Don't do this: */
:focus { outline: none; } /* Removes accessibility */
```

## Brand Styles Reference

### Brutalist
Raw HTML aesthetic, high contrast, monospace fonts. Use for: Art galleries, experimental studios.

### Neumorphic
Soft shadows, raised/recessed effects, monochromatic. Use for: Apps, dashboards (sparingly—accessibility concerns).

### Glassmorphic
Frosted glass effects, transparency, depth. Use for: Modern apps, overlays, cards.

### Minimalist
Maximum whitespace, typography-focused, limited palette. Use for: Luxury brands, portfolios.

### Editorial
Magazine-inspired, mixed typography, large imagery. Use for: Blogs, news sites, storytelling.

<style>
/* ============================================
   DESIGN TOKENS
   ============================================ */
:root {
  /* OKLCH Color Palette */
  --bg-primary: oklch(10% 0.005 265);
  --bg-surface: oklch(16% 0.006 265);
  --bg-surface-hover: oklch(22% 0.008 265);
  --bg-elevated: oklch(20% 0.008 265);
  --text-primary: oklch(97% 0.005 265);
  --text-secondary: oklch(68% 0.02 265);
  --text-muted: oklch(52% 0.015 265);
  --accent-blue: oklch(62% 0.2 265);
  --accent-blue-hover: oklch(68% 0.22 265);
  --accent-amber: oklch(76% 0.16 75);
  --accent-amber-hover: oklch(80% 0.18 75);
  --border-subtle: oklch(24% 0.01 265);
  --border-medium: oklch(32% 0.015 265);

  --sp-1: 4px;
  --sp-2: 8px;
  --sp-3: 16px;

  --sp-5: 32px;
  --sp-6: 48px;

  --radius-md: 12px;
  --radius-lg: 20px;
  --radius-full: 9999px;

  /* Transitions */
  --ease-out: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
  --ease-in-out: cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1);
  --duration-fast: 200ms;
  --duration-normal: 350ms;
  --duration-slow: 600ms;

  /* Layout */
  --max-width: 1280px;
  --nav-height: 72px;
}

/* ============================================
   RESET & BASE
   ============================================ */
*, *::before, *::after {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

html {
  scroll-behavior: smooth;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
}

body {
  font-family: var(--font-family);
  background: var(--bg-primary);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-size: var(--fs-body);
  line-height: 1.6;
  overflow-x: hidden;
}

a {
  color: inherit;
  text-decoration: none;
}

button {
  font-family: inherit;
  cursor: pointer;
  border: none;
  background: none;
  color: inherit;
}

ul, ol { list-style: none; }
img { max-width: 100%; display: block; }

:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--accent-blue);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

/* ============================================
   UTILITY
   ============================================ */
.container {
  max-width: var(--max-width);
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0 var(--sp-5);
}

.section-gap {
  padding: var(--sp-9) 0;
}

.accent-text {
  color: var(--accent-blue);
}

.btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--sp-2);
  padding: var(--sp-3) var(--sp-5);
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: var(--fs-small);
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  transition: all var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.btn-primary {
  background: var(--accent-blue);
  color: oklch(10% 0.01 265);
}

.btn-primary:hover {
  background: var(--accent-blue-hover);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.btn-outline {
  border: 1px solid var(--border-medium);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.btn-outline:hover {
  border-color: var(--accent-blue);
  color: var(--accent-blue);
}

.btn-amber {
  background: var(--accent-amber);
  color: oklch(10% 0.01 265);
}

.btn-amber:hover {
  background: var(--accent-amber-hover);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.section-label {
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--accent-blue);
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-4);
}

.section-title {
  font-size: var(--fs-h2);
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.1;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
}

.section-subtitle {
  font-size: var(--fs-h4);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  line-height: 1.5;
  max-width: 680px;
  margin-top: var(--sp-4);
}

/* ============================================
   NAVIGATION
   ============================================ */
.nav {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  z-index: 1000;
  height: var(--nav-height);
  background: oklch(10% 0.005 265 / 0.85);
  backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  border-bottom: 1px solid oklch(24% 0.01 265 / 0.5);
  transition: background var(--duration-fast);
}

.nav-inner {
  max-width: var(--max-width);
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0 var(--sp-5);
  height: 100%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
}

.nav-brand {
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.nav-brand span {
  color: var(--accent-blue);
}

.nav-links {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--sp-5);
}

.nav-links a {
  font-size: var(--fs-small);
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  transition: color var(--duration-fast);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.nav-links a:hover {
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.nav-right {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--sp-4);
}

/* Language Selector */
.lang-selector {
  position: relative;
}

.lang-toggle {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--sp-1);
  font-size: var(--fs-small);
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  padding: var(--sp-2) var(--sp-3);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  transition: all var(--duration-fast);
}

.lang-toggle:hover {
  border-color: var(--border-medium);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.lang-toggle svg {
  width: 14px;
  height: 14px;
  transition: transform var(--duration-fast);
}

.lang-selector.open .lang-toggle svg {
  transform: rotate(180deg);
}

.lang-dropdown {
  position: absolute;
  top: calc(100% + var(--sp-2));
  right: 0;
  background: var(--bg-elevated);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: var(--sp-2) 0;
  min-width: 160px;
  opacity: 0;
  visibility: hidden;
  transform: translateY(-8px);
  transition: all var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out);
}

.lang-selector.open .lang-dropdown {
  opacity: 1;
  visibility: visible;
  transform: translateY(0);
}

.lang-option {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--sp-2);
  padding: var(--sp-2) var(--sp-4);
  font-size: var(--fs-small);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  width: 100%;
  transition: all var(--duration-fast);
}

.lang-option:hover {
  background: var(--bg-surface-hover);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.lang-option.active {
  color: var(--accent-blue);
}

/* Hamburger */
.nav-hamburger {
  display: none;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 5px;
  padding: var(--sp-2);
}

.nav-hamburger span {
  display: block;
  width: 22px;
  height: 2px;
  background: var(--text-primary);
  border-radius: 1px;
  transition: all var(--duration-fast);
}

.nav-hamburger.active span:nth-child(1) {
  transform: rotate(45deg) translate(5px, 5px);
}

.nav-hamburger.active span:nth-child(2) {
  opacity: 0;
}

.nav-hamburger.active span:nth-child(3) {
  transform: rotate(-45deg) translate(5px, -5px);
}

/* Mobile Nav */
.mobile-nav {
  display: none;
  position: fixed;
  top: var(--nav-height);
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  background: var(--bg-primary);
  z-index: 999;
  padding: var(--sp-6);
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(-10px);
  transition: all var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out);
}

.mobile-nav.open {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translateY(0);
}

.mobile-nav a {
  display: block;
  font-size: var(--fs-h3);
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  padding: var(--sp-3) 0;
  transition: color var(--duration-fast);
}

.mobile-nav a:hover {
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

@media (max-width: 1023px) {
  .nav-links { display: none; }
  .nav-hamburger { display: flex; }
  .mobile-nav { display: block; }
}

/* ============================================
   HERO CAROUSEL
   ============================================ */
.hero {
  position: relative;
  min-height: calc(100vh - var(--nav-height));
  margin-top: var(--nav-height);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.hero-track {
  display: flex;
  transition: transform var(--duration-slow) var(--ease-in-out);
  height: 100%;
}

.hero-slide {
  min-width: 100%;
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  min-height: calc(100vh - var(--nav-height));
}

.hero-slide-bg {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 0;
}

.hero-slide-bg::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(10% 0.005 265 / 0.92), oklch(10% 0.005 265 / 0.6));
}

.hero-slide-content {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  max-width: var(--max-width);
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: var(--sp-8) var(--sp-5);
  width: 100%;
}

.hero-slide-tag {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--sp-2);
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--accent-blue);
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-5);
}

.hero-slide-tag::before {
  content: '';
  width: 24px;
  height: 2px;
  background: var(--accent-blue);
}

.hero-slide-title {
  font-size: var(--fs-hero);
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.05;
  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
  max-width: 800px;
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-5);
}

.hero-slide-desc {
  font-size: var(--fs-h4);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  max-width: 560px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-6);
}

/* Hero Navigation */
.hero-nav {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: var(--sp-7);
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--sp-3);
  z-index: 2;
}

.hero-dot {
  width: 32px;
  height: 3px;
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: oklch(40% 0.01 265);
  transition: all var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out);
  cursor: pointer;
}

.hero-dot.active {
  width: 48px;
  background: var(--accent-blue);
}

.hero-arrows {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: var(--sp-7);
  right: var(--sp-5);
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--sp-2);
  z-index: 2;
}

.hero-arrow {
  width: 48px;
  height: 48px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-medium);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  transition: all var(--duration-fast);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.hero-arrow:hover {
  border-color: var(--accent-blue);
  color: var(--accent-blue);
}

.hero-arrow svg {
  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
}

/* Placeholder backgrounds for hero slides */
.hero-slide:nth-child(1) .hero-slide-bg {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(25% 0.06 280), oklch(15% 0.04 240));
}

.hero-slide:nth-child(2) .hero-slide-bg {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(22% 0.05 200), oklch(18% 0.04 260));
}

.hero-slide:nth-child(3) .hero-slide-bg {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(20% 0.06 300), oklch(14% 0.03 220));
}

.hero-slide:nth-child(4) .hero-slide-bg {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(23% 0.05 180), oklch(16% 0.04 250));
}

.hero-slide:nth-child(5) .hero-slide-bg {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(21% 0.06 320), oklch(15% 0.04 240));
}

/* ============================================
   TEAM CAROUSEL
   ============================================ */
.team {
  background: var(--bg-primary);
}

.team-header {
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-7);
}

/* Region Tabs */
.region-tabs {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--sp-1);
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-6);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  overflow-x: auto;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
}

.region-tab {
  padding: var(--sp-3) var(--sp-4);
  font-size: var(--fs-small);
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
  transition: all var(--duration-fast);
  white-space: nowrap;
  margin-bottom: -1px;
}

.region-tab:hover {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.region-tab.active {
  color: var(--accent-blue);
  border-bottom-color: var(--accent-blue);
}

/* Team Cards Carousel */
.team-carousel-wrapper {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.team-carousel {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--sp-5);
  transition: transform var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out);
  padding-bottom: var(--sp-4);
}

.team-card {
  min-width: 340px;
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  overflow: hidden;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  transition: border-color var(--duration-fast);
}

.team-card:hover {
  border-color: var(--border-medium);
}

.team-card-photo {
  width: 100%;
  height: 240px;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.team-card-photo-placeholder {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 48px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: oklch(30% 0.01 265);
}

.team-card:nth-child(odd) .team-card-photo-placeholder {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(28% 0.03 260), oklch(22% 0.05 280));
}

.team-card:nth-child(even) .team-card-photo-placeholder {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(26% 0.04 290), oklch(20% 0.03 250));
}

.team-card-body {
  padding: var(--sp-5);
}

.team-card-name {
  font-size: var(--fs-h4);
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-1);
}

.team-card-title {
  font-size: var(--fs-small);
  color: var(--accent-blue);
  font-weight: 500;
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-3);
}

.team-card-quote {
  font-size: var(--fs-small);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  line-height: 1.6;
  font-style: italic;
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-4);
  position: relative;
  padding-left: var(--sp-3);
  border-left: 2px solid var(--accent-blue);
}

.team-card-cta {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--sp-2);
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  transition: color var(--duration-fast);
}

.team-card-cta:hover {
  color: var(--accent-blue);
}

.team-card-cta svg {
  width: 14px;
  height: 14px;
  transition: transform var(--duration-fast);
}

.team-card-cta:hover svg {
  transform: translateX(3px);
}

/* Team Carousel Controls */
.team-carousel-nav {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--sp-2);
  margin-top: var(--sp-5);
}

.team-carousel-btn {
  width: 44px;
  height: 44px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  transition: all var(--duration-fast);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.team-carousel-btn:hover {
  border-color: var(--accent-blue);
  color: var(--accent-blue);
}

.team-carousel-btn:disabled {
  opacity: 0.3;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}

.team-carousel-btn:disabled:hover {
  border-color: var(--border-subtle);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.team-carousel-btn svg {
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
}

/* ============================================
   WORK SHOWCASE
   ============================================ */
.work {
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
}

.work-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: flex-end;
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-6);
  gap: var(--sp-5);
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.work-scroll-container {
  overflow-x: auto;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
  scrollbar-width: none;
  -ms-overflow-style: none;
  scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;
  padding-bottom: var(--sp-3);
}

.work-scroll-container::-webkit-scrollbar {
  display: none;
}

.work-cards {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--sp-5);
}

.work-card {
  min-width: 360px;
  max-width: 420px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  scroll-snap-align: start;
  background: var(--bg-primary);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: all var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out);
}

.work-card:hover {
  border-color: var(--border-medium);
  transform: translateY(-4px);
}

.work-card-img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 220px;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.work-card-img-placeholder {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.work-card:nth-child(1) .work-card-img-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(30% 0.06 180), oklch(20% 0.04 240)); }
.work-card:nth-child(2) .work-card-img-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(28% 0.05 300), oklch(18% 0.04 260)); }
.work-card:nth-child(3) .work-card-img-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(26% 0.06 140), oklch(22% 0.04 200)); }
.work-card:nth-child(4) .work-card-img-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(32% 0.05 250), oklch(16% 0.04 300)); }
.work-card:nth-child(5) .work-card-img-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(24% 0.06 320), oklch(20% 0.04 260)); }
.work-card:nth-child(6) .work-card-img-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(28% 0.05 160), oklch(22% 0.04 220)); }
.work-card:nth-child(7) .work-card-img-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(30% 0.04 280), oklch(18% 0.05 200)); }
.work-card:nth-child(8) .work-card-img-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(26% 0.06 220), oklch(20% 0.03 180)); }

.work-card-img-text {
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: oklch(50% 0.03 265);
}

.work-card-body {
  padding: var(--sp-5);
}

.work-card-client {
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--accent-blue);
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-2);
}

.work-card-title {
  font-size: var(--fs-h4);
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.3;
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-3);
}

.work-card-quote {
  font-size: var(--fs-small);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  line-height: 1.5;
  font-style: italic;
}

.work-card-link {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--sp-2);
  font-size: var(--fs-small);
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--accent-blue);
  margin-top: var(--sp-4);
  transition: gap var(--duration-fast);
}

.work-card-link:hover {
  gap: var(--sp-3);
}

/* ============================================
   CTA BANNER
   ============================================ */
.cta-banner {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.cta-banner-inner {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(25% 0.08 265), oklch(18% 0.06 290));
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: var(--sp-8) var(--sp-7);
  text-align: center;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.cta-banner-inner::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: -50%;
  right: -20%;
  width: 400px;
  height: 400px;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, oklch(62% 0.2 265 / 0.15), transparent 70%);
  border-radius: 50%;
}

.cta-banner-inner::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  bottom: -40%;
  left: -10%;
  width: 300px;
  height: 300px;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, oklch(76% 0.16 75 / 0.1), transparent 70%);
  border-radius: 50%;
}

.cta-banner-content {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}

.cta-banner h2 {
  font-size: var(--fs-h2);
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-4);
}

.cta-banner p {
  font-size: var(--fs-h4);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  max-width: 600px;
  margin: 0 auto var(--sp-6);
  line-height: 1.5;
}

/* ============================================
   HOW WE WORK
   ============================================ */
.how {
  background: var(--bg-primary);
}

.how-inner {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: var(--sp-8);
  align-items: center;
}

.how-visual {
  position: relative;
  aspect-ratio: 4/3;
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.how-visual-placeholder {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(22% 0.06 270), oklch(16% 0.04 290), oklch(20% 0.05 250));
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.how-visual-text {
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: oklch(40% 0.03 265);
}

.how-content {
  max-width: 520px;
}

.how-content .section-label {
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-3);
}

.how-content h2 {

.cookie-inner {

/* Cookie Settings Modal */
.cookie-modal-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  background: oklch(10% 0.005 265 / 0.8);
  z-index: 3000;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  opacity: 0;
  visibility: hidden;
  transition: all var(--duration-fast);
}

.cookie-modal-overlay.visible {
  opacity: 1;
  visibility: visible;
}

.cookie-modal {
  background: var(--bg-elevated);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: var(--sp-6);
  max-width: 520px;
  width: 90%;
  max-height: 80vh;
  overflow-y: auto;
  transform: scale(0.95);
  transition: transform var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out);
}

.cookie-modal-overlay.visible .cookie-modal {
  transform: scale(1);
}

.cookie-modal h3 {
  font-size: var(--fs-h3);
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-4);
}

.cookie-modal p {

  color: var(--text-secondary);
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-5);
  line-height: 1.6;
}

.cookie-option {

  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;

  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
}

.cookie-option:last-child {

}

.cookie-option-label {

  font-weight: 500;
}

.cookie-option-label span {

  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
  color: var(--text-muted);

  margin-top: var(--sp-1);
}

/* Toggle Switch */
.toggle {
  position: relative;
  width: 44px;
  height: 24px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.toggle input {
  opacity: 0;
  width: 0;
  height: 0;
}

.toggle-slider {
  position: absolute;
  cursor: pointer;
  inset: 0;
  background: oklch(32% 0.01 265);
  border-radius: 12px;
  transition: background var(--duration-fast);
}

.toggle-slider::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  height: 18px;
  width: 18px;
  left: 3px;
  bottom: 3px;
  background: var(--text-primary);
  border-radius: 50%;
  transition: transform var(--duration-fast);
}

.toggle input:checked + .toggle-slider {
  background: var(--accent-blue);
}

.toggle input:checked + .toggle-slider::before {
  transform: translateX(20px);
}

.toggle input:disabled + .toggle-slider {
  opacity: 0.5;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}

.cookie-modal-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--sp-3);
  margin-top: var(--sp-5);
}

<script>
(function() {
  'use strict';

  // ============================================
  // TEAM DATA
  // ============================================
  const teamData = {
    'north-america': [
      {
        name: 'Denice Alvarez',
        title: 'Office Manager',
        office: 'New York',
        initials: 'DA',
        quote: 'As the Office Manager, I engage with teams from every discipline, and have learned so much through my day-to-day interactions with my fellow leapers.'

      {

        initials: 'MB',

      }
    ],
    'asia': [
      {
        name: 'Priya Mehta',
        title: 'Studio Head',
        office: 'Bangalore',
        initials: 'PM',
        quote: 'We bring your brand vision to life, with transformative ideas and impactful marketing campaigns fueled by creativity and enthusiasm.'
      },
      {
        name: 'Thierry Lam',
        title: 'Design Lead',
        office: 'Singapore',
        initials: 'TL',
        quote: 'Good design is multifaceted. It impacts functionality, aesthetics, strategy, environment, business and so much more. Great design is seamless.'
      }
    ],
    'europe': [
      {
        name: 'Gavin Hartley',
        title: 'Managing Director',
        office: 'London',
        initials: 'GH',
        quote: "It's my job to make sure we innovate and push the boundaries when collaborating with brands to create inspiring customer experiences that deliver great business results."
      },
      {
        name: 'Francesca Terzi',
        title: 'Design Director',
        office: 'Munich',
        initials: 'FT',
        quote: 'At Leap Studio, I am constantly amazed by the talent I am surrounded with. We love to dream big and bring those dreams to life.'
      }
    ],
    'oceania': [
      {
        name: 'Jacintha Soo Ho',
        title: 'Senior Manager, CX Transformation',
        office: 'Melbourne',
        initials: 'JS',
        quote: 'I love helping clients see beyond their assumptions and showing them opportunities they haven\'t thought of before.'
      }
    ]
  };

  let currentRegion = 'north-america';
  let teamOffset = 0;

  // ============================================
  // HERO CAROUSEL
  // ============================================
  const heroTrack = document.getElementById('heroTrack');
  const heroDots = document.querySelectorAll('.hero-dot');
  const heroPrev = document.getElementById('heroPrev');
  const heroNext = document.getElementById('heroNext');
  const totalSlides = 5;
  let currentSlide = 0;
  let heroAutoplay;

  function goToSlide(index) {
    currentSlide = ((index % totalSlides) + totalSlides) % totalSlides;
    heroTrack.style.transform = `translateX(-${currentSlide * 100}%)`;
    heroDots.forEach((dot, i) => {
      dot.classList.toggle('active', i === currentSlide);
    });
  }

  function startHeroAutoplay() {
    stopHeroAutoplay();
    heroAutoplay = setInterval(() => goToSlide(currentSlide + 1), 6000);
  }

  function stopHeroAutoplay() {
    if (heroAutoplay) clearInterval(heroAutoplay);
  }

  heroDots.forEach(dot => {
    dot.addEventListener('click', () => {
      goToSlide(parseInt(dot.dataset.slide));
      startHeroAutoplay();
    });
  });

  heroPrev.addEventListener('click', () => { goToSlide(currentSlide - 1); startHeroAutoplay(); });
  heroNext.addEventListener('click', () => { goToSlide(currentSlide + 1); startHeroAutoplay(); });

  // Touch support for hero
  let heroTouchStartX = 0;
  const heroEl = document.getElementById('hero');
  heroEl.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => { heroTouchStartX = e.touches[0].clientX; }, { passive: true });
  heroEl.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
    const diff = heroTouchStartX - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
    if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) {
      goToSlide(diff > 0 ? currentSlide + 1 : currentSlide - 1);
      startHeroAutoplay();
    }
  }, { passive: true });

  startHeroAutoplay();

  // ============================================
  // TEAM CAROUSEL
  // ============================================
  const teamCarousel = document.getElementById('teamCarousel');
  const teamPrevBtn = document.getElementById('teamPrev');
  const teamNextBtn = document.getElementById('teamNext');
  const regionTabs = document.querySelectorAll('.region-tab');

  function renderTeamCards(region) {
    const members = teamData[region] || [];
    teamCarousel.innerHTML = members.map(m => `
      <div class="team-card">
        <div class="team-card-photo">
          <div class="team-card-photo-placeholder">${m.initials}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="team-card-body">
          <div class="team-card-name">${m.name}</div>
          <div class="team-card-title">${m.title}</div>
          <div class="team-card-quote">${m.quote}</div>
          <a href="#" class="team-card-cta">
            Contact Leap Studio ${m.office}
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M5 12h14M12 5l7 7-7 7"/></svg>
          </a>
        </div>
      </div>
    `).join('');
    teamOffset = 0;
    teamCarousel.style.transform = 'translateX(0)';
    updateTeamNav();
  }

  function updateTeamNav() {
    const members = teamData[currentRegion] || [];
    const cardWidth = 340 + 32; // min-width + gap
    const visibleWidth = teamCarousel.parentElement.offsetWidth;
    const totalWidth = members.length * cardWidth;
    const maxOffset = Math.max(0, totalWidth - visibleWidth);
    teamPrevBtn.disabled = teamOffset <= 0;
    teamNextBtn.disabled = teamOffset >= maxOffset;
  }

  function scrollTeam(direction) {
    const cardWidth = 340 + 32;
    const visibleWidth = teamCarousel.parentElement.offsetWidth;
    const members = teamData[currentRegion] || [];
    const totalWidth = members.length * cardWidth;
    const maxOffset = Math.max(0, totalWidth - visibleWidth);
    const step = Math.min(cardWidth, visibleWidth);

    teamOffset = Math.max(0, Math.min(maxOffset, teamOffset + direction * step));
    teamCarousel.style.transform = `translateX(-${teamOffset}px)`;
    updateTeamNav();
  }

  regionTabs.forEach(tab => {
    tab.addEventListener('click', () => {
      regionTabs.forEach(t => { t.classList.remove('active'); t.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'false'); });
      tab.classList.add('active');
      tab.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');
      currentRegion = tab.dataset.region;
      renderTeamCards(currentRegion);
    });
  });

  teamPrevBtn.addEventListener('click', () => scrollTeam(-1));
  teamNextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => scrollTeam(1));

  // Touch support for team carousel
  let teamTouchStartX = 0;
  teamCarousel.parentElement.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
    teamTouchStartX = e.touches[0].clientX;
  }, { passive: true });
  teamCarousel.parentElement.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
    const diff = teamTouchStartX - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
    if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) scrollTeam(diff > 0 ? 1 : -1);
  }, { passive: true });

  // Initialize
  renderTeamCards(currentRegion);
  window.addEventListener('resize', () => updateTeamNav());

  // ============================================
  // LANGUAGE SELECTOR
  // ============================================
  const langSelector = document.getElementById('langSelector');
  const langToggle = document.getElementById('langToggle');
  const langOptions = document.querySelectorAll('.lang-option');

  langToggle.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    const isOpen = langSelector.classList.toggle('open');
    langToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', isOpen);
  });

  langOptions.forEach(opt => {
    opt.addEventListener('click', () => {
      langOptions.forEach(o => { o.classList.remove('active'); o.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'false'); });
      opt.classList.add('active');
      opt.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');
      langToggle.innerHTML = `
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><path d="M2 12h20M12 2a15.3 15.3 0 0 1 4 10 15.3 15.3 0 0 1-4 10 15.3 15.3 0 0 1-4-10 15.3 15.3 0 0 1 4-10z"/></svg>
        ${opt.textContent}
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><polyline points="6 9 12 15 18 9"/></svg>
      `;
      langSelector.classList.remove('open');
      langToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    });
  });

  document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    if (!langSelector.contains(e.target)) {
      langSelector.classList.remove('open');
      langToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    }
  });

  // ============================================
  // MOBILE NAV
  // ============================================
  const navHamburger = document.getElementById('navHamburger');
  const mobileNav = document.getElementById('mobileNav');

  navHamburger.addEventListener('click', () => {
    navHamburger.classList.toggle('active');
    mobileNav.classList.toggle('open');
    document.body.style.overflow = mobileNav.classList.contains('open') ? 'hidden' : '';
  });

  document.querySelectorAll('.mobile-nav-link').forEach(link => {
    link.addEventListener('click', () => {
      navHamburger.classList.remove('active');
      mobileNav.classList.remove('open');
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    });
  });

  // ============================================
  // COOKIE CONSENT
  // ============================================
  const cookieBanner = document.getElementById('cookieBanner');
  const cookieModal = document.getElementById('cookieModal');
  const cookieAccept = document.getElementById('cookieAccept');
  const cookieDecline = document.getElementById('cookieDecline');
  const cookieManage = document.getElementById('cookieManage');
  const cookieModalAccept = document.getElementById('cookieModalAccept');
  const cookieModalDecline = document.getElementById('cookieModalDecline');
  const cookieSettingsBtn = document.getElementById('cookieSettingsBtn');
  const cookieSettingsLink = document.getElementById('cookieSettingsLink');

  // Show banner on load if no consent stored
  if (!localStorage.getItem('cookie-consent')) {
    setTimeout(() => cookieBanner.classList.add('visible'), 1000);
  }

  function hideBanner() {
    cookieBanner.classList.remove('visible');
  }

  cookieAccept.addEventListener('click', () => {
    localStorage.setItem('cookie-consent', 'accepted');
    hideBanner();
  });

  cookieDecline.addEventListener('click', () => {
    localStorage.setItem('cookie-consent', 'declined');
    hideBanner();
  });

  cookieManage.addEventListener('click', () => {
    cookieModal.classList.add('visible');
  });

  cookieModalAccept.addEventListener('click', () => {
    localStorage.setItem('cookie-consent', 'custom');
    cookieModal.classList.remove('visible');
    hideBanner();
  });

  cookieModalDecline.addEventListener('click', () => {
    localStorage.setItem('cookie-consent', 'declined');
    document.getElementById('cookiePerformance').checked = false;
    document.getElementById('cookieFunctional').checked = false;
    document.getElementById('cookieTargeting').checked = false;
    cookieModal.classList.remove('visible');
    hideBanner();
  });

  function openCookieSettings(e) {
    if (e) e.preventDefault();
    cookieModal.classList.add('visible');
  }

  if (cookieSettingsBtn) cookieSettingsBtn.addEventListener('click', openCookieSettings);
  if (cookieSettingsLink) cookieSettingsLink.addEventListener('click', openCookieSettings);

  cookieModal.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    if (e.target === cookieModal) cookieModal.classList.remove('visible');
  });

  // ============================================
  // SMOOTH SCROLL FOR NAV LINKS
  // ============================================
  document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(anchor => {
    anchor.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      const target = document.querySelector(this.getAttribute('href'));
      if (target) {
        e.preventDefault();
        target.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
      }
    });
  });

  // ============================================
  // NAV SCROLL EFFECT
  // ============================================
  const nav = document.getElementById('nav');
  let lastScroll = 0;
  window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
    const scroll = window.scrollY;
    if (scroll > 100) {
      nav.style.borderBottomColor = 'oklch(24% 0.01 265 / 0.8)';
    } else {
      nav.style.borderBottomColor = 'oklch(24% 0.01 265 / 0.5)';
    }
    lastScroll = scroll;
  }, { passive: true });

})();
</script>
</body>

<style>
/* ============================================
   DESIGN TOKENS
   ============================================ */
:root {
  /* OKLCH Color Palette */
  --bg-primary: oklch(10% 0.005 265);
  --bg-surface: oklch(16% 0.006 265);
  --bg-surface-hover: oklch(22% 0.008 265);
  --bg-elevated: oklch(20% 0.008 265);
  --text-primary: oklch(97% 0.005 265);
  --text-secondary: oklch(68% 0.02 265);
  --text-muted: oklch(52% 0.015 265);
  --accent-blue: oklch(62% 0.2 265);
  --accent-blue-hover: oklch(68% 0.22 265);
  --accent-amber: oklch(76% 0.16 75);
  --accent-amber-hover: oklch(80% 0.18 75);
  --border-subtle: oklch(24% 0.01 265);
  --border-medium: oklch(32% 0.015 265);

  /* Spacing (8px base) */
  --sp-1: 4px;
  --sp-2: 8px;
  --sp-3: 16px;
  --sp-4: 24px;
  --sp-5: 32px;
  --sp-6: 48px;
  --sp-7: 64px;
  --sp-8: 96px;
  --sp-9: 128px;

  /* Typography */
  --font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;
  --fs-hero: clamp(40px, 6vw, 72px);
  --fs-h2: clamp(32px, 4vw, 48px);
  --fs-h3: clamp(20px, 2.5vw, 28px);
  --fs-h4: clamp(16px, 1.5vw, 20px);
  --fs-body: 16px;
  --fs-small: 14px;
  --fs-xs: 12px;

  /* Radius */
  --radius-sm: 6px;
  --radius-md: 12px;
  --radius-lg: 20px;
  --radius-full: 9999px;

  /* Transitions */
  --ease-out: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
  --ease-in-out: cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1);
  --duration-fast: 200ms;
  --duration-normal: 350ms;
  --duration-slow: 600ms;

  /* Layout */
  --max-width: 1280px;
  --nav-height: 72px;
}

/* ============================================
   RESET & BASE
   ============================================ */
*, *::before, *::after {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

html {
  scroll-behavior: smooth;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
}

body {
  font-family: var(--font-family);
  background: var(--bg-primary);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-size: var(--fs-body);

  overflow-x: hidden;
}

a {
  color: inherit;
  text-decoration: none;
}

button {
  font-family: inherit;
  cursor: pointer;
  border: none;
  background: none;
  color: inherit;
}

ul, ol { list-style: none; }
img { max-width: 100%; display: block; }

:focus-visible {

}

/* ============================================
   UTILITY
   ============================================ */
.container {

  margin: 0 auto;

}

.section-gap {

}

.accent-text {
  color: var(--accent-blue);
}

.btn {

}

.btn-primary {
  background: var(--accent-blue);
  color: oklch(10% 0.01 265);
}

.btn-primary:hover {
  background: var(--accent-blue-hover);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.btn-outline {
  border: 1px solid var(--border-medium);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.btn-outline:hover {
  border-color: var(--accent-blue);
  color: var(--accent-blue);
}

.btn-amber {
  background: var(--accent-amber);

}

.btn-amber:hover {

.section-label {

/* ============================================

.nav {

.nav-inner {

}

.nav-brand {

.nav-links {

.nav-right {

.lang-selector {

.nav-hamburger.active span:nth-child(2) {

.nav-hamburger.active span:nth-child(3) {

/* Mobile Nav */
.mobile-nav {

/* ============================================

/* Team Cards Carousel */

    if (heroAutoplay) clearInterval(heroAutoplay);
  }

  heroDots.forEach(dot => {
    dot.addEventListener('click', () => {
      goToSlide(parseInt(dot.dataset.slide));
      startHeroAutoplay();
    });
  });

  heroPrev.addEventListener('click', () => { goToSlide(currentSlide - 1); startHeroAutoplay(); });
  heroNext.addEventListener('click', () => { goToSlide(currentSlide + 1); startHeroAutoplay(); });

  // Touch support for hero
  let heroTouchStartX = 0;
  const heroEl = document.getElementById('hero');
  heroEl.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => { heroTouchStartX = e.touches[0].clientX; }, { passive: true });
  heroEl.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
    const diff = heroTouchStartX - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
    if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) {
      goToSlide(diff > 0 ? currentSlide + 1 : currentSlide - 1);
      startHeroAutoplay();
    }
  }, { passive: true });

  startHeroAutoplay();

  // ============================================
  // TEAM CAROUSEL
  // ============================================
  const teamCarousel = document.getElementById('teamCarousel');
  const teamPrevBtn = document.getElementById('teamPrev');
  const teamNextBtn = document.getElementById('teamNext');
  const regionTabs = document.querySelectorAll('.region-tab');

  function renderTeamCards(region) {
    const members = teamData[region] || [];
    teamCarousel.innerHTML = members.map(m => `
      <div class="team-card">
        <div class="team-card-photo">
          <div class="team-card-photo-placeholder">${m.initials}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="team-card-body">
          <div class="team-card-name">${m.name}</div>
          <div class="team-card-title">${m.title}</div>
          <div class="team-card-quote">${m.quote}</div>
          <a href="#" class="team-card-cta">
            Contact Leap Studio ${m.office}
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M5 12h14M12 5l7 7-7 7"/></svg>
          </a>
        </div>
      </div>
    `).join('');
    teamOffset = 0;
    teamCarousel.style.transform = 'translateX(0)';
    updateTeamNav();
  }

  function updateTeamNav() {
    const members = teamData[currentRegion] || [];
    const cardWidth = 340 + 32; // min-width + gap
    const visibleWidth = teamCarousel.parentElement.offsetWidth;
    const totalWidth = members.length * cardWidth;
    const maxOffset = Math.max(0, totalWidth - visibleWidth);
    teamPrevBtn.disabled = teamOffset <= 0;
    teamNextBtn.disabled = teamOffset >= maxOffset;
  }

  function scrollTeam(direction) {
    const cardWidth = 340 + 32;
    const visibleWidth = teamCarousel.parentElement.offsetWidth;
    const members = teamData[currentRegion] || [];
    const totalWidth = members.length * cardWidth;
    const maxOffset = Math.max(0, totalWidth - visibleWidth);
    const step = Math.min(cardWidth, visibleWidth);

    teamOffset = Math.max(0, Math.min(maxOffset, teamOffset + direction * step));
    teamCarousel.style.transform = `translateX(-${teamOffset}px)`;
    updateTeamNav();
  }

    tab.addEventListener('click', () => {
      regionTabs.forEach(t => { t.classList.remove('active'); t.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'false'); });

      tab.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');
      currentRegion = tab.dataset.region;
      renderTeamCards(currentRegion);
    });
  });

  teamPrevBtn.addEventListener('click', () => scrollTeam(-1));
  teamNextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => scrollTeam(1));

  // Touch support for team carousel
  let teamTouchStartX = 0;
  teamCarousel.parentElement.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
    teamTouchStartX = e.touches[0].clientX;
  }, { passive: true });
  teamCarousel.parentElement.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
    const diff = teamTouchStartX - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
    if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) scrollTeam(diff > 0 ? 1 : -1);
  }, { passive: true });

  // Initialize
  renderTeamCards(currentRegion);
  window.addEventListener('resize', () => updateTeamNav());

  // ============================================
  // LANGUAGE SELECTOR
  // ============================================
  const langSelector = document.getElementById('langSelector');
  const langToggle = document.getElementById('langToggle');
  const langOptions = document.querySelectorAll('.lang-option');

  langToggle.addEventListener('click', (e) => {

    const isOpen = langSelector.classList.toggle('open');
    langToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', isOpen);
  });

  langOptions.forEach(opt => {
    opt.addEventListener('click', () => {
      langOptions.forEach(o => { o.classList.remove('active'); o.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'false'); });
      opt.classList.add('active');
      opt.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');

  navHamburger.addEventListener('click', () => {

    document.body.style.overflow = mobileNav.classList.contains('open') ? 'hidden' : '';
  });

  document.querySelectorAll('.mobile-nav-link').forEach(link => {
    link.addEventListener('click', () => {
      navHamburger.classList.remove('active');
      mobileNav.classList.remove('open');
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    });
  });

  // ============================================
  // COOKIE CONSENT
  // ============================================
  const cookieBanner = document.getElementById('cookieBanner');
  const cookieModal = document.getElementById('cookieModal');
  const cookieAccept = document.getElementById('cookieAccept');
  const cookieDecline = document.getElementById('cookieDecline');
  const cookieManage = document.getElementById('cookieManage');
  const cookieModalAccept = document.getElementById('cookieModalAccept');
  const cookieModalDecline = document.getElementById('cookieModalDecline');
  const cookieSettingsBtn = document.getElementById('cookieSettingsBtn');
  const cookieSettingsLink = document.getElementById('cookieSettingsLink');

  // Show banner on load if no consent stored
  if (!localStorage.getItem('cookie-consent')) {
    setTimeout(() => cookieBanner.classList.add('visible'), 1000);
  }

  function hideBanner() {
    cookieBanner.classList.remove('visible');
  }

  cookieAccept.addEventListener('click', () => {
    localStorage.setItem('cookie-consent', 'accepted');
    hideBanner();
  });

  cookieDecline.addEventListener('click', () => {
    localStorage.setItem('cookie-consent', 'declined');
    hideBanner();
  });

  cookieManage.addEventListener('click', () => {
    cookieModal.classList.add('visible');
  });

  cookieModalAccept.addEventListener('click', () => {
    localStorage.setItem('cookie-consent', 'custom');
    cookieModal.classList.remove('visible');
    hideBanner();
  });

  cookieModalDecline.addEventListener('click', () => {
    localStorage.setItem('cookie-consent', 'declined');
    document.getElementById('cookiePerformance').checked = false;
    document.getElementById('cookieFunctional').checked = false;
    document.getElementById('cookieTargeting').checked = false;
    cookieModal.classList.remove('visible');
    hideBanner();
  });

  function openCookieSettings(e) {
    if (e) e.preventDefault();
    cookieModal.classList.add('visible');
  }

  if (cookieSettingsBtn) cookieSettingsBtn.addEventListener('click', openCookieSettings);
  if (cookieSettingsLink) cookieSettingsLink.addEventListener('click', openCookieSettings);

  cookieModal.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    if (e.target === cookieModal) cookieModal.classList.remove('visible');
  });

  // ============================================
  // SMOOTH SCROLL FOR NAV LINKS
  // ============================================
  document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(anchor => {
    anchor.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      const target = document.querySelector(this.getAttribute('href'));
      if (target) {
        e.preventDefault();
        target.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
      }
    });
  });

  // ============================================
  // NAV SCROLL EFFECT
  // ============================================
  const nav = document.getElementById('nav');
  let lastScroll = 0;
  window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
    const scroll = window.scrollY;

      nav.style.borderBottomColor = 'oklch(24% 0.01 265 / 0.8)';
    } else {
      nav.style.borderBottomColor = 'oklch(24% 0.01 265 / 0.5)';
    }
    lastScroll = scroll;
  }, { passive: true });

})();
