.region-tabs {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--sp-1);
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-6);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  overflow-x: auto;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
}

.region-tab {
  padding: var(--sp-3) var(--sp-4);
  font-size: var(--fs-small);
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
  transition: all var(--duration-fast);
  white-space: nowrap;
  margin-bottom: -1px;
}

.region-tab:hover {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.region-tab.active {
  color: var(--accent-blue);
  border-bottom-color: var(--accent-blue);
}

/* Team Cards Carousel */
.team-carousel-wrapper {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.team-carousel {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--sp-5);
  transition: transform var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out);
  padding-bottom: var(--sp-4);
}

.team-card {
  min-width: 340px;
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  overflow: hidden;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  transition: border-color var(--duration-fast);
}

.team-card:hover {
  border-color: var(--border-medium);
}

.team-card-photo {
  width: 100%;
  height: 240px;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.team-card-photo-placeholder {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 48px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: oklch(30% 0.01 265);
}

.team-card:nth-child(odd) .team-card-photo-placeholder {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(28% 0.03 260), oklch(22% 0.05 280));
}

.team-card:nth-child(even) .team-card-photo-placeholder {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(26% 0.04 290), oklch(20% 0.03 250));
}

.team-card-body {
  padding: var(--sp-5);
}

.team-card-name {
  font-size: var(--fs-h4);
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-1);
}

.team-card-title {
  font-size: var(--fs-small);
  color: var(--accent-blue);
  font-weight: 500;
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-3);
}

.team-card-quote {
  font-size: var(--fs-small);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  line-height: 1.6;
  font-style: italic;
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-4);
  position: relative;
  padding-left: var(--sp-3);
  border-left: 2px solid var(--accent-blue);
}

.team-card-cta {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--sp-2);
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  transition: color var(--duration-fast);
}

.team-card-cta:hover {
  color: var(--accent-blue);
}

.team-card-cta svg {
  width: 14px;
  height: 14px;
  transition: transform var(--duration-fast);
}

.team-card-cta:hover svg {
  transform: translateX(3px);
}

/* Team Carousel Controls */
.team-carousel-nav {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--sp-2);
  margin-top: var(--sp-5);
}

.team-carousel-btn {
  width: 44px;
  height: 44px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  transition: all var(--duration-fast);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.team-carousel-btn:hover {
  border-color: var(--accent-blue);
  color: var(--accent-blue);
}

.team-carousel-btn:disabled {
  opacity: 0.3;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}

.team-carousel-btn:disabled:hover {
  border-color: var(--border-subtle);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.team-carousel-btn svg {
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
}

/* ============================================
   WORK SHOWCASE
   ============================================ */
.work {
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
}

.work-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: flex-end;
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-6);
  gap: var(--sp-5);
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.work-scroll-container {
  overflow-x: auto;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
  scrollbar-width: none;
  -ms-overflow-style: none;
  scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;
  padding-bottom: var(--sp-3);
}

.work-scroll-container::-webkit-scrollbar {
  display: none;
}

.work-cards {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--sp-5);
}

.work-card {
  min-width: 360px;
  max-width: 420px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  scroll-snap-align: start;
  background: var(--bg-primary);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: all var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out);
}

.work-card:hover {
  border-color: var(--border-medium);
  transform: translateY(-4px);
}

.work-card-img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 220px;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.work-card-img-placeholder {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.work-card:nth-child(1) .work-card-img-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(30% 0.06 180), oklch(20% 0.04 240)); }
.work-card:nth-child(2) .work-card-img-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(28% 0.05 300), oklch(18% 0.04 260)); }
.work-card:nth-child(3) .work-card-img-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(26% 0.06 140), oklch(22% 0.04 200)); }
.work-card:nth-child(4) .work-card-img-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(32% 0.05 250), oklch(16% 0.04 300)); }
.work-card:nth-child(5) .work-card-img-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(24% 0.06 320), oklch(20% 0.04 260)); }
.work-card:nth-child(6) .work-card-img-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(28% 0.05 160), oklch(22% 0.04 220)); }
.work-card:nth-child(7) .work-card-img-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(30% 0.04 280), oklch(18% 0.05 200)); }
.work-card:nth-child(8) .work-card-img-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(26% 0.06 220), oklch(20% 0.03 180)); }

.work-card-img-text {
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: oklch(50% 0.03 265);
}

.work-card-body {
  padding: var(--sp-5);
}

.work-card-client {
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--accent-blue);
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-2);
}

.work-card-title {
  font-size: var(--fs-h4);
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.3;
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-3);
}

.work-card-quote {
  font-size: var(--fs-small);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  line-height: 1.5;
  font-style: italic;
}

.work-card-link {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--sp-2);
  font-size: var(--fs-small);
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--accent-blue);
  margin-top: var(--sp-4);
  transition: gap var(--duration-fast);
}

.work-card-link:hover {
  gap: var(--sp-3);
}

/* ============================================
   CTA BANNER
   ============================================ */
.cta-banner {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.cta-banner-inner {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(25% 0.08 265), oklch(18% 0.06 290));
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: var(--sp-8) var(--sp-7);
  text-align: center;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.cta-banner-inner::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: -50%;
  right: -20%;
  width: 400px;
  height: 400px;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, oklch(62% 0.2 265 / 0.15), transparent 70%);
  border-radius: 50%;
}

.cta-banner-inner::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  bottom: -40%;
  left: -10%;
  width: 300px;
  height: 300px;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, oklch(76% 0.16 75 / 0.1), transparent 70%);
  border-radius: 50%;
}

.cta-banner-content {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}

.cta-banner h2 {
  font-size: var(--fs-h2);
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-4);
}

.cta-banner p {
  font-size: var(--fs-h4);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  max-width: 600px;
  margin: 0 auto var(--sp-6);
  line-height: 1.5;
}

/* ============================================
   HOW WE WORK
   ============================================ */
.how {
  background: var(--bg-primary);
}

.how-inner {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: var(--sp-8);
  align-items: center;
}

.how-visual {
  position: relative;
  aspect-ratio: 4/3;
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.how-visual-placeholder {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(22% 0.06 270), oklch(16% 0.04 290), oklch(20% 0.05 250));
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.how-visual-text {
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: oklch(40% 0.03 265);
}

.how-content {
  max-width: 520px;
}

.how-content .section-label {
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-3);
}

.how-content h2 {
  font-size: var(--fs-h2);
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.1;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-4);
}

.how-content p {
  font-size: var(--fs-body);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  line-height: 1.7;
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-6);
}

/* ============================================
   LATEST INSIGHTS
   ============================================ */
.insights {
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
}

.insights-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: flex-end;
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-6);
  gap: var(--sp-5);
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.insights-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(280px, 1fr));
  gap: var(--sp-5);
}

.insight-card {
  background: var(--bg-primary);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: all var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out);
}

.insight-card:hover {
  border-color: var(--border-medium);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.insight-card-img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 160px;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.insight-card-img-placeholder {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.insight-card:nth-child(1) .insight-card-img-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(24% 0.05 280), oklch(18% 0.04 240)); }
.insight-card:nth-child(2) .insight-card-img-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(26% 0.04 300), oklch(20% 0.05 260)); }
.insight-card:nth-child(3) .insight-card-img-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(22% 0.06 200), oklch(16% 0.03 240)); }
.insight-card:nth-child(4) .insight-card-img-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(28% 0.05 260), oklch(18% 0.04 300)); }
.insight-card:nth-child(5) .insight-card-img-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(24% 0.04 320), oklch(20% 0.05 280)); }
.insight-card:nth-child(6) .insight-card-img-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(26% 0.06 220), oklch(16% 0.03 200)); }
.insight-card:nth-child(7) .insight-card-img-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(22% 0.05 180), oklch(18% 0.04 260)); }
.insight-card:nth-child(8) .insight-card-img-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(28% 0.04 290), oklch(20% 0.05 240)); }

.insight-card-img-text {
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: oklch(45% 0.03 265);
}

.insight-card-body {
  padding: var(--sp-4) var(--sp-5) var(--sp-5);
}

.insight-card-type {
  display: inline-block;
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--accent-amber);
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-2);
}

.insight-card-type.podcast {
  color: oklch(70% 0.18 145);
}

.insight-card-type.report {
  color: oklch(68% 0.16 300);
}

.insight-card-title {
  font-size: var(--fs-body);
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1.4;
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-3);
}

.insight-card-link {
  font-size: var(--fs-small);
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--accent-blue);
  transition: opacity var(--duration-fast);
}

.insight-card-link:hover {
  opacity: 0.8;
}

/* ============================================
   PRINCIPLES
   ============================================ */
.principles {
  background: var(--bg-primary);
}

.principles-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  gap: var(--sp-5);
  margin-top: var(--sp-7);
}

.principle-card {
  padding: var(--sp-6);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  transition: all var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.principle-card::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 3px;
  height: 100%;
  background: var(--accent-blue);
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity var(--duration-fast);
}

.principle-card:hover {
  border-color: var(--border-medium);
}

.principle-card:hover::before {
  opacity: 1;
}

.principle-number {
  font-size: var(--fs-h2);
  font-weight: 800;
  color: oklch(20% 0.01 265);
  line-height: 1;
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-4);
}

.principle-card:hover .principle-number {
  color: oklch(30% 0.06 265);
}

.principle-title {
  font-size: var(--fs-h3);
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-3);
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.principle-desc {
  font-size: var(--fs-small);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  line-height: 1.7;
}

/* ============================================
   FOOTER
   ============================================ */
.footer {
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
}

.footer-ctas {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: var(--sp-5);
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-8);
}

.footer-cta-card {
  padding: var(--sp-6);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  transition: border-color var(--duration-fast);
}

.footer-cta-card:hover {
  border-color: var(--border-medium);
}

.footer-cta-card p {
  font-size: var(--fs-h4);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  line-height: 1.5;
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-4);
}

.footer-cta-card .btn {
  margin-top: var(--sp-2);
}

.footer-bottom {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: var(--sp-5);
  padding: var(--sp-6) 0;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.footer-links {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--sp-5);
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.footer-links a {
  font-size: var(--fs-small);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  transition: color var(--duration-fast);
}

.footer-links a:hover {
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.footer-legal {
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--sp-4);
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.footer-legal a {
  color: var(--text-muted);
  transition: color var(--duration-fast);
}

.footer-legal a:hover {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.footer-brand {
  font-size: 14px;
  color: var(--text-muted);
}

/* ============================================
   COOKIE CONSENT
   ============================================ */
.cookie-banner {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  z-index: 2000;
  background: var(--bg-elevated);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  padding: var(--sp-5);
  transform: translateY(100%);
  transition: transform var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out);
}

.cookie-banner.visible {
  transform: translateY(0);
}

.cookie-inner {
  max-width: var(--max-width);
  margin: 0 auto;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--sp-5);
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.cookie-text {
  font-size: var(--fs-small);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  max-width: 600px;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.cookie-text a {
  color: var(--accent-blue);
  text-decoration: underline;
}

.cookie-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--sp-3);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.cookie-actions .btn {
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
  padding: var(--sp-2) var(--sp-4);
}

/* Cookie Settings Modal */
.cookie-modal-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  background: oklch(10% 0.005 265 / 0.8);
  z-index: 3000;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  opacity: 0;
  visibility: hidden;
  transition: all var(--duration-fast);
}

.cookie-modal-overlay.visible {
  opacity: 1;
  visibility: visible;
}

.cookie-modal {
  background: var(--bg-elevated);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: var(--sp-6);
  max-width: 520px;
  width: 90%;
  max-height: 80vh;
  overflow-y: auto;
  transform: scale(0.95);
  transition: transform var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out);
}

.cookie-modal-overlay.visible .cookie-modal {
  transform: scale(1);
}

.cookie-modal h3 {
  font-size: var(--fs-h3);
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-4);
}

.cookie-modal p {
  font-size: var(--fs-small);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-5);
  line-height: 1.6;
}

.cookie-option {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  padding: var(--sp-3) 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
}

.cookie-option:last-child {
  border-bottom: none;
}

.cookie-option-label {
  font-size: var(--fs-small);
  font-weight: 500;
}

.cookie-option-label span {
  display: block;
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-weight: 400;
  margin-top: var(--sp-1);
}

/* Toggle Switch */
.toggle {
  position: relative;
  width: 44px;
  height: 24px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.toggle input {
  opacity: 0;
  width: 0;
  height: 0;
}

.toggle-slider {
  position: absolute;
  cursor: pointer;
  inset: 0;
  background: oklch(32% 0.01 265);
  border-radius: 12px;
  transition: background var(--duration-fast);
}

.toggle-slider::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  height: 18px;
  width: 18px;
  left: 3px;
  bottom: 3px;
  background: var(--text-primary);
  border-radius: 50%;
  transition: transform var(--duration-fast);
}

.toggle input:checked + .toggle-slider {
  background: var(--accent-blue);
}

.toggle input:checked + .toggle-slider::before {
  transform: translateX(20px);
}

.toggle input:disabled + .toggle-slider {
  opacity: 0.5;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}

.cookie-modal-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--sp-3);
  margin-top: var(--sp-5);
}

/* ============================================
   RESPONSIVE
   ============================================ */
@media (max-width: 1023px) {
  .hero-slide-title {
    max-width: 100%;
  }

  .hero-arrows {
    display: none;
  }

  .how-inner {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: var(--sp-6);
  }

  .how-visual {
    aspect-ratio: 16/9;
  }

  .principles-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .footer-ctas {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .footer-bottom {
    flex-direction: column;
  }

  .team-card {
    min-width: 300px;
  }

  .work-card {
    min-width: 300px;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 639px) {
  :root {
    --sp-9: 80px;
    --sp-8: 64px;
    --sp-7: 48px;
  }

  .hero-slide {
    min-height: auto;

<!-- ============================================

<script>
(function() {
  'use strict';

  // ============================================
  // TEAM DATA
  // ============================================
  const teamData = {
    'north-america': [
      {
        name: 'Denice Alvarez',
        title: 'Office Manager',
        office: 'New York',
        initials: 'DA',
        quote: 'As the Office Manager, I engage with teams from every discipline, and have learned so much through my day-to-day interactions with my fellow leapers.'
      },
      {
        name: 'Marco Bellini',
        title: 'Design Director',
        office: 'San Francisco',
        initials: 'MB',
        quote: 'Every day we are delighted by the immense beauty that nature holds. When engaged in the act of creation, it is our responsibility to channel that delight into the things we make.'
      }
    ],
    'asia': [
      {
        name: 'Priya Mehta',
        title: 'Studio Head',
        office: 'Bangalore',
        initials: 'PM',
        quote: 'We bring your brand vision to life, with transformative ideas and impactful marketing campaigns fueled by creativity and enthusiasm.'
      },
      {
        name: 'Thierry Lam',
        title: 'Design Lead',
        office: 'Singapore',
        initials: 'TL',
        quote: 'Good design is multifaceted. It impacts functionality, aesthetics, strategy, environment, business and so much more. Great design is seamless.'
      }
    ],
    'europe': [
      {
        name: 'Gavin Hartley',
        title: 'Managing Director',
        office: 'London',
        initials: 'GH',
        quote: "It's my job to make sure we innovate and push the boundaries when collaborating with brands to create inspiring customer experiences that deliver great business results."
      },
      {
        name: 'Francesca Terzi',
        title: 'Design Director',
        office: 'Munich',
        initials: 'FT',
        quote: 'At Leap Studio, I am constantly amazed by the talent I am surrounded with. We love to dream big and bring those dreams to life.'
      }
    ],
    'oceania': [
      {
        name: 'Jacintha Soo Ho',
        title: 'Senior Manager, CX Transformation',
        office: 'Melbourne',
        initials: 'JS',
        quote: 'I love helping clients see beyond their assumptions and showing them opportunities they haven\'t thought of before.'
      }
    ]
  };

  let currentRegion = 'north-america';
  let teamOffset = 0;

  // ============================================
  // HERO CAROUSEL
  // ============================================
  const heroTrack = document.getElementById('heroTrack');
  const heroDots = document.querySelectorAll('.hero-dot');
  const heroPrev = document.getElementById('heroPrev');
  const heroNext = document.getElementById('heroNext');
  const totalSlides = 5;
  let currentSlide = 0;
  let heroAutoplay;

  function goToSlide(index) {
    currentSlide = ((index % totalSlides) + totalSlides) % totalSlides;
    heroTrack.style.transform = `translateX(-${currentSlide * 100}%)`;
    heroDots.forEach((dot, i) => {
      dot.classList.toggle('active', i === currentSlide);
    });
  }

  function startHeroAutoplay() {
    stopHeroAutoplay();
    heroAutoplay = setInterval(() => goToSlide(currentSlide + 1), 6000);
  }

  function stopHeroAutoplay() {
    if (heroAutoplay) clearInterval(heroAutoplay);
  }

  heroDots.forEach(dot => {
    dot.addEventListener('click', () => {
      goToSlide(parseInt(dot.dataset.slide));
      startHeroAutoplay();
    });
  });

  heroPrev.addEventListener('click', () => { goToSlide(currentSlide - 1); startHeroAutoplay(); });
  heroNext.addEventListener('click', () => { goToSlide(currentSlide + 1); startHeroAutoplay(); });

  // Touch support for hero
  let heroTouchStartX = 0;
  const heroEl = document.getElementById('hero');
  heroEl.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => { heroTouchStartX = e.touches[0].clientX; }, { passive: true });
  heroEl.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
    const diff = heroTouchStartX - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
    if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) {
      goToSlide(diff > 0 ? currentSlide + 1 : currentSlide - 1);
      startHeroAutoplay();
    }
  }, { passive: true });

  startHeroAutoplay();

  // ============================================
  // TEAM CAROUSEL
  // ============================================
  const teamCarousel = document.getElementById('teamCarousel');
  const teamPrevBtn = document.getElementById('teamPrev');
  const teamNextBtn = document.getElementById('teamNext');
  const regionTabs = document.querySelectorAll('.region-tab');

  function renderTeamCards(region) {
    const members = teamData[region] || [];
    teamCarousel.innerHTML = members.map(m => `
      <div class="team-card">
        <div class="team-card-photo">
          <div class="team-card-photo-placeholder">${m.initials}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="team-card-body">
          <div class="team-card-name">${m.name}</div>
          <div class="team-card-title">${m.title}</div>
          <div class="team-card-quote">${m.quote}</div>
          <a href="#" class="team-card-cta">
            Contact Leap Studio ${m.office}
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M5 12h14M12 5l7 7-7 7"/></svg>
          </a>
        </div>
      </div>
    `).join('');
    teamOffset = 0;
    teamCarousel.style.transform = 'translateX(0)';
    updateTeamNav();
  }

  function updateTeamNav() {
    const members = teamData[currentRegion] || [];
    const cardWidth = 340 + 32; // min-width + gap
    const visibleWidth = teamCarousel.parentElement.offsetWidth;
    const totalWidth = members.length * cardWidth;
    const maxOffset = Math.max(0, totalWidth - visibleWidth);
    teamPrevBtn.disabled = teamOffset <= 0;
    teamNextBtn.disabled = teamOffset >= maxOffset;
  }

  function scrollTeam(direction) {
    const cardWidth = 340 + 32;
    const visibleWidth = teamCarousel.parentElement.offsetWidth;
    const members = teamData[currentRegion] || [];
    const totalWidth = members.length * cardWidth;
    const maxOffset = Math.max(0, totalWidth - visibleWidth);
    const step = Math.min(cardWidth, visibleWidth);

    teamOffset = Math.max(0, Math.min(maxOffset, teamOffset + direction * step));
    teamCarousel.style.transform = `translateX(-${teamOffset}px)`;
    updateTeamNav();
  }

  regionTabs.forEach(tab => {
    tab.addEventListener('click', () => {
      regionTabs.forEach(t => { t.classList.remove('active'); t.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'false'); });
      tab.classList.add('active');
      tab.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');
      currentRegion = tab.dataset.region;
      renderTeamCards(currentRegion);
    });
  });

  teamPrevBtn.addEventListener('click', () => scrollTeam(-1));
  teamNextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => scrollTeam(1));

  // Touch support for team carousel
  let teamTouchStartX = 0;
  teamCarousel.parentElement.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
    teamTouchStartX = e.touches[0].clientX;
  }, { passive: true });
  teamCarousel.parentElement.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
    const diff = teamTouchStartX - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
    if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) scrollTeam(diff > 0 ? 1 : -1);
  }, { passive: true });

  // Initialize
  renderTeamCards(currentRegion);
  window.addEventListener('resize', () => updateTeamNav());

  // ============================================
  // LANGUAGE SELECTOR
  // ============================================
  const langSelector = document.getElementById('langSelector');
  const langToggle = document.getElementById('langToggle');
  const langOptions = document.querySelectorAll('.lang-option');

  langToggle.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    const isOpen = langSelector.classList.toggle('open');
    langToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', isOpen);
  });

  langOptions.forEach(opt => {
    opt.addEventListener('click', () => {
      langOptions.forEach(o => { o.classList.remove('active'); o.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'false'); });
      opt.classList.add('active');
      opt.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');
      langToggle.innerHTML = `
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><path d="M2 12h20M12 2a15.3 15.3 0 0 1 4 10 15.3 15.3 0 0 1-4 10 15.3 15.3 0 0 1-4-10 15.3 15.3 0 0 1 4-10z"/></svg>
        ${opt.textContent}
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><polyline points="6 9 12 15 18 9"/></svg>
      `;
      langSelector.classList.remove('open');
      langToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    });
  });

  document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    if (!langSelector.contains(e.target)) {
      langSelector.classList.remove('open');
      langToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    }
  });

  // ============================================
  // MOBILE NAV
  // ============================================
  const navHamburger = document.getElementById('navHamburger');
  const mobileNav = document.getElementById('mobileNav');

  navHamburger.addEventListener('click', () => {
    navHamburger.classList.toggle('active');
    mobileNav.classList.toggle('open');
    document.body.style.overflow = mobileNav.classList.contains('open') ? 'hidden' : '';
  });

  document.querySelectorAll('.mobile-nav-link').forEach(link => {
    link.addEventListener('click', () => {
      navHamburger.classList.remove('active');
      mobileNav.classList.remove('open');
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    });
  });

  // ============================================
  // COOKIE CONSENT
  // ============================================
  const cookieBanner = document.getElementById('cookieBanner');
  const cookieModal = document.getElementById('cookieModal');
  const cookieAccept = document.getElementById('cookieAccept');
  const cookieDecline = document.getElementById('cookieDecline');
  const cookieManage = document.getElementById('cookieManage');
  const cookieModalAccept = document.getElementById('cookieModalAccept');
  const cookieModalDecline = document.getElementById('cookieModalDecline');
  const cookieSettingsBtn = document.getElementById('cookieSettingsBtn');
  const cookieSettingsLink = document.getElementById('cookieSettingsLink');

  // Show banner on load if no consent stored
  if (!localStorage.getItem('cookie-consent')) {
    setTimeout(() => cookieBanner.classList.add('visible'), 1000);
  }

  function hideBanner() {
    cookieBanner.classList.remove('visible');
  }

  cookieAccept.addEventListener('click', () => {
    localStorage.setItem('cookie-consent', 'accepted');
    hideBanner();
  });

  cookieDecline.addEventListener('click', () => {
    localStorage.setItem('cookie-consent', 'declined');
    hideBanner();
  });

  cookieManage.addEventListener('click', () => {
    cookieModal.classList.add('visible');
  });

  cookieModalAccept.addEventListener('click', () => {
    localStorage.setItem('cookie-consent', 'custom');
    cookieModal.classList.remove('visible');
    hideBanner();
  });

  cookieModalDecline.addEventListener('click', () => {
    localStorage.setItem('cookie-consent', 'declined');
    document.getElementById('cookiePerformance').checked = false;
    document.getElementById('cookieFunctional').checked = false;
    document.getElementById('cookieTargeting').checked = false;
    cookieModal.classList.remove('visible');
    hideBanner();
  });

  function openCookieSettings(e) {
    if (e) e.preventDefault();
    cookieModal.classList.add('visible');
  }

  if (cookieSettingsBtn) cookieSettingsBtn.addEventListener('click', openCookieSettings);
  if (cookieSettingsLink) cookieSettingsLink.addEventListener('click', openCookieSettings);

  cookieModal.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    if (e.target === cookieModal) cookieModal.classList.remove('visible');
  });

  // ============================================
  // SMOOTH SCROLL FOR NAV LINKS
  // ============================================
  document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(anchor => {
    anchor.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      const target = document.querySelector(this.getAttribute('href'));
      if (target) {
        e.preventDefault();
        target.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
      }
    });
  });

  // ============================================
  // NAV SCROLL EFFECT
  // ============================================
  const nav = document.getElementById('nav');
  let lastScroll = 0;
  window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
    const scroll = window.scrollY;
    if (scroll > 100) {
      nav.style.borderBottomColor = 'oklch(24% 0.01 265 / 0.8)';
    } else {
      nav.style.borderBottomColor = 'oklch(24% 0.01 265 / 0.5)';
    }
    lastScroll = scroll;
  }, { passive: true });

})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

  --accent-blue-hover: oklch(68% 0.22 265);
  --accent-amber: oklch(76% 0.16 75);

  --radius-sm: 6px;

  /* Transitions */
  --ease-out: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);

}

/* ============================================

*, *::before, *::after {

}

.nav-hamburger.active span:nth-child(3) {
  transform: rotate(-45deg) translate(5px, -5px);
}

/* Mobile Nav */
.mobile-nav {
  display: none;
  position: fixed;
  top: var(--nav-height);
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  background: var(--bg-primary);
  z-index: 999;
  padding: var(--sp-6);
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(-10px);
  transition: all var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out);
}

.mobile-nav.open {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translateY(0);
}

.mobile-nav a {
  display: block;
  font-size: var(--fs-h3);
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  padding: var(--sp-3) 0;
  transition: color var(--duration-fast);
}

.mobile-nav a:hover {
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

@media (max-width: 1023px) {
  .nav-links { display: none; }
  .nav-hamburger { display: flex; }
  .mobile-nav { display: block; }
}

/* ============================================
   HERO CAROUSEL
   ============================================ */
.hero {
  position: relative;
  min-height: calc(100vh - var(--nav-height));
  margin-top: var(--nav-height);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.hero-track {
  display: flex;
  transition: transform var(--duration-slow) var(--ease-in-out);
  height: 100%;
}

.hero-slide {
  min-width: 100%;
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  min-height: calc(100vh - var(--nav-height));
}

.hero-slide-bg {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 0;
}

.hero-slide-bg::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(10% 0.005 265 / 0.92), oklch(10% 0.005 265 / 0.6));
}

.hero-slide-content {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  max-width: var(--max-width);
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: var(--sp-8) var(--sp-5);
  width: 100%;
}

.hero-slide-tag {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--sp-2);
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--accent-blue);
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-5);
}

.hero-slide-tag::before {
  content: '';
  width: 24px;
  height: 2px;
  background: var(--accent-blue);
}

.hero-slide-title {
  font-size: var(--fs-hero);
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.05;
  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
  max-width: 800px;
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-5);
}

.hero-slide-desc {
  font-size: var(--fs-h4);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  max-width: 560px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-6);
}

/* Hero Navigation */
.hero-nav {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: var(--sp-7);
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--sp-3);
  z-index: 2;
}

.hero-dot {
  width: 32px;
  height: 3px;
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: oklch(40% 0.01 265);
  transition: all var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out);
  cursor: pointer;
}

.hero-dot.active {
  width: 48px;
  background: var(--accent-blue);
}

.hero-arrows {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: var(--sp-7);
  right: var(--sp-5);
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--sp-2);
  z-index: 2;
}

.hero-arrow {
  width: 48px;
  height: 48px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-medium);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  transition: all var(--duration-fast);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.hero-arrow:hover {
  border-color: var(--accent-blue);
  color: var(--accent-blue);
}

.hero-arrow svg {
  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
}

/* Placeholder backgrounds for hero slides */
.hero-slide:nth-child(1) .hero-slide-bg {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(25% 0.06 280), oklch(15% 0.04 240));
}

.hero-slide:nth-child(2) .hero-slide-bg {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(22% 0.05 200), oklch(18% 0.04 260));
}

.hero-slide:nth-child(3) .hero-slide-bg {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(20% 0.06 300), oklch(14% 0.03 220));
}

.hero-slide:nth-child(4) .hero-slide-bg {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(23% 0.05 180), oklch(16% 0.04 250));
}

.hero-slide:nth-child(5) .hero-slide-bg {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(21% 0.06 320), oklch(15% 0.04 240));
}

/* ============================================
   TEAM CAROUSEL
   ============================================ */
.team {
  background: var(--bg-primary);
}

.team-header {
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-7);
}

/* Region Tabs */
.region-tabs {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--sp-1);
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-6);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  overflow-x: auto;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
}

.region-tab {
  padding: var(--sp-3) var(--sp-4);
  font-size: var(--fs-small);
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
  transition: all var(--duration-fast);
  white-space: nowrap;
  margin-bottom: -1px;
}

.region-tab:hover {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.region-tab.active {
  color: var(--accent-blue);
  border-bottom-color: var(--accent-blue);
}

/* Team Cards Carousel */
.team-carousel-wrapper {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.team-carousel {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--sp-5);
  transition: transform var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out);
  padding-bottom: var(--sp-4);
}

.team-card {
  min-width: 340px;
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  overflow: hidden;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  transition: border-color var(--duration-fast);
}

.team-card:hover {
  border-color: var(--border-medium);
}

.team-card-photo {
  width: 100%;
  height: 240px;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.team-card-photo-placeholder {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 48px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: oklch(30% 0.01 265);
}

.team-card:nth-child(odd) .team-card-photo-placeholder {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(28% 0.03 260), oklch(22% 0.05 280));
}

.team-card:nth-child(even) .team-card-photo-placeholder {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(26% 0.04 290), oklch(20% 0.03 250));
}

.team-card-body {
  padding: var(--sp-5);
}

.team-card-name {
  font-size: var(--fs-h4);
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-1);
}

.team-card-title {
  font-size: var(--fs-small);
  color: var(--accent-blue);
  font-weight: 500;
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-3);
}

.team-card-quote {
  font-size: var(--fs-small);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  line-height: 1.6;
  font-style: italic;
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-4);
  position: relative;
  padding-left: var(--sp-3);
  border-left: 2px solid var(--accent-blue);
}

.team-card-cta {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--sp-2);
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  transition: color var(--duration-fast);
}

.team-card-cta:hover {
  color: var(--accent-blue);
}

.team-card-cta svg {
  width: 14px;
  height: 14px;
  transition: transform var(--duration-fast);
}

.team-card-cta:hover svg {
  transform: translateX(3px);
}

/* Team Carousel Controls */
.team-carousel-nav {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--sp-2);
  margin-top: var(--sp-5);
}

.team-carousel-btn {
  width: 44px;
  height: 44px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  transition: all var(--duration-fast);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.team-carousel-btn:hover {
  border-color: var(--accent-blue);
  color: var(--accent-blue);
}

.team-carousel-btn:disabled {
  opacity: 0.3;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}

.team-carousel-btn:disabled:hover {
  border-color: var(--border-subtle);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.team-carousel-btn svg {
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
}

/* ============================================
   WORK SHOWCASE
   ============================================ */
.work {
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
}

.work-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: flex-end;
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-6);
  gap: var(--sp-5);
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.work-scroll-container {
  overflow-x: auto;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
  scrollbar-width: none;
  -ms-overflow-style: none;
  scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;
  padding-bottom: var(--sp-3);
}

.work-scroll-container::-webkit-scrollbar {
  display: none;
}

.work-cards {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--sp-5);
}

.work-card {
  min-width: 360px;
  max-width: 420px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  scroll-snap-align: start;
  background: var(--bg-primary);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: all var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out);
}

.work-card:hover {
  border-color: var(--border-medium);
  transform: translateY(-4px);
}

.work-card-img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 220px;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.work-card-img-placeholder {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.work-card:nth-child(1) .work-card-img-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(30% 0.06 180), oklch(20% 0.04 240)); }
.work-card:nth-child(2) .work-card-img-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(28% 0.05 300), oklch(18% 0.04 260)); }
.work-card:nth-child(3) .work-card-img-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(26% 0.06 140), oklch(22% 0.04 200)); }
.work-card:nth-child(4) .work-card-img-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(32% 0.05 250), oklch(16% 0.04 300)); }
.work-card:nth-child(5) .work-card-img-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(24% 0.06 320), oklch(20% 0.04 260)); }
.work-card:nth-child(6) .work-card-img-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(28% 0.05 160), oklch(22% 0.04 220)); }
.work-card:nth-child(7) .work-card-img-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(30% 0.04 280), oklch(18% 0.05 200)); }
.work-card:nth-child(8) .work-card-img-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(26% 0.06 220), oklch(20% 0.03 180)); }

.work-card-img-text {
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: oklch(50% 0.03 265);
}

.work-card-body {
  padding: var(--sp-5);
}

.work-card-client {
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--accent-blue);
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-2);
}

.work-card-title {
  font-size: var(--fs-h4);
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.3;
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-3);
}

.work-card-quote {
  font-size: var(--fs-small);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  line-height: 1.5;
  font-style: italic;
}

.work-card-link {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--sp-2);
  font-size: var(--fs-small);
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--accent-blue);
  margin-top: var(--sp-4);
  transition: gap var(--duration-fast);
}

.work-card-link:hover {
  gap: var(--sp-3);
}

/* ============================================
   CTA BANNER
   ============================================ */
.cta-banner {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.cta-banner-inner {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(25% 0.08 265), oklch(18% 0.06 290));
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: var(--sp-8) var(--sp-7);
  text-align: center;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.cta-banner-inner::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: -50%;
  right: -20%;
  width: 400px;
  height: 400px;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, oklch(62% 0.2 265 / 0.15), transparent 70%);
  border-radius: 50%;
}

.cta-banner-inner::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  bottom: -40%;
  left: -10%;
  width: 300px;
  height: 300px;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, oklch(76% 0.16 75 / 0.1), transparent 70%);
  border-radius: 50%;
}

.cta-banner-content {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}

.cta-banner h2 {
  font-size: var(--fs-h2);
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-4);
}

.cta-banner p {
  font-size: var(--fs-h4);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  max-width: 600px;
  margin: 0 auto var(--sp-6);
  line-height: 1.5;
}

/* ============================================
   HOW WE WORK
   ============================================ */
.how {
  background: var(--bg-primary);
}

.how-inner {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: var(--sp-8);
  align-items: center;
}

.how-visual {
  position: relative;
  aspect-ratio: 4/3;
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.how-visual-placeholder {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(22% 0.06 270), oklch(16% 0.04 290), oklch(20% 0.05 250));
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.how-visual-text {
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: oklch(40% 0.03 265);
}

.how-content {
  max-width: 520px;
}

.how-content .section-label {
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-3);
}

.how-content h2 {
  font-size: var(--fs-h2);
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.1;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-4);
}

.how-content p {
  font-size: var(--fs-body);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  line-height: 1.7;
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-6);
}

/* ============================================
   LATEST INSIGHTS
   ============================================ */
.insights {
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
}

.insights-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: flex-end;
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-6);
  gap: var(--sp-5);
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.insights-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(280px, 1fr));
  gap: var(--sp-5);
}

.insight-card {
  background: var(--bg-primary);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: all var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out);
}

.insight-card:hover {
  border-color: var(--border-medium);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.insight-card-img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 160px;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.insight-card-img-placeholder {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.insight-card:nth-child(1) .insight-card-img-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(24% 0.05 280), oklch(18% 0.04 240)); }
.insight-card:nth-child(2) .insight-card-img-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(26% 0.04 300), oklch(20% 0.05 260)); }
.insight-card:nth-child(3) .insight-card-img-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(22% 0.06 200), oklch(16% 0.03 240)); }
.insight-card:nth-child(4) .insight-card-img-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(28% 0.05 260), oklch(18% 0.04 300)); }
.insight-card:nth-child(5) .insight-card-img-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(24% 0.04 320), oklch(20% 0.05 280)); }
.insight-card:nth-child(6) .insight-card-img-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(26% 0.06 220), oklch(16% 0.03 200)); }
.insight-card:nth-child(7) .insight-card-img-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(22% 0.05 180), oklch(18% 0.04 260)); }
.insight-card:nth-child(8) .insight-card-img-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(28% 0.04 290), oklch(20% 0.05 240)); }

.insight-card-img-text {
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: oklch(45% 0.03 265);
}

.insight-card-body {
  padding: var(--sp-4) var(--sp-5) var(--sp-5);
}

.insight-card-type {
  display: inline-block;
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--accent-amber);
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-2);
}

.insight-card-type.podcast {
  color: oklch(70% 0.18 145);
}

.insight-card-type.report {
  color: oklch(68% 0.16 300);
}

.insight-card-title {
  font-size: var(--fs-body);
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1.4;
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-3);
}

.insight-card-link {
  font-size: var(--fs-small);
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--accent-blue);
  transition: opacity var(--duration-fast);
}

.insight-card-link:hover {
  opacity: 0.8;
}

/* ============================================
   PRINCIPLES
   ============================================ */
.principles {
  background: var(--bg-primary);
}

.principles-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  gap: var(--sp-5);
  margin-top: var(--sp-7);
}

.principle-card {
  padding: var(--sp-6);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  transition: all var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.principle-card::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 3px;
  height: 100%;
  background: var(--accent-blue);
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity var(--duration-fast);
}

.principle-card:hover {
  border-color: var(--border-medium);
}

.principle-card:hover::before {
  opacity: 1;
}

.principle-number {
  font-size: var(--fs-h2);
  font-weight: 800;
  color: oklch(20% 0.01 265);
  line-height: 1;
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-4);
}

.principle-card:hover .principle-number {
  color: oklch(30% 0.06 265);
}

.principle-title {
  font-size: var(--fs-h3);
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-3);
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.principle-desc {
  font-size: var(--fs-small);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  line-height: 1.7;
}

/* ============================================
   FOOTER
   ============================================ */
.footer {
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
}

.footer-ctas {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: var(--sp-5);
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-8);
}

.footer-cta-card {
  padding: var(--sp-6);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  transition: border-color var(--duration-fast);
}

.footer-cta-card:hover {
  border-color: var(--border-medium);
}

.footer-cta-card p {
  font-size: var(--fs-h4);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  line-height: 1.5;
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-4);
}

.footer-cta-card .btn {
  margin-top: var(--sp-2);
}

.footer-bottom {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: var(--sp-5);
  padding: var(--sp-6) 0;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.footer-links {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--sp-5);
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.footer-links a {
  font-size: var(--fs-small);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  transition: color var(--duration-fast);
}

.footer-links a:hover {
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.footer-legal {
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);

.footer-legal a:hover {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.footer-brand {
  font-size: 14px;

}

/* ============================================
   COOKIE CONSENT
   ============================================ */
.cookie-banner {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  z-index: 2000;
  background: var(--bg-elevated);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  padding: var(--sp-5);
  transform: translateY(100%);
  transition: transform var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out);
}

.cookie-banner.visible {
  transform: translateY(0);
}

.cookie-inner {
  max-width: var(--max-width);
  margin: 0 auto;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--sp-5);
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.cookie-text {
  font-size: var(--fs-small);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  max-width: 600px;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.cookie-text a {
  color: var(--accent-blue);
  text-decoration: underline;
}

.cookie-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--sp-3);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.cookie-actions .btn {
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
  padding: var(--sp-2) var(--sp-4);
}

/* Cookie Settings Modal */
.cookie-modal-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  background: oklch(10% 0.005 265 / 0.8);
  z-index: 3000;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  opacity: 0;
  visibility: hidden;
  transition: all var(--duration-fast);
}

.cookie-modal-overlay.visible {
  opacity: 1;
  visibility: visible;
}

.cookie-modal {
  background: var(--bg-elevated);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: var(--sp-6);
  max-width: 520px;
  width: 90%;
  max-height: 80vh;
  overflow-y: auto;
  transform: scale(0.95);
  transition: transform var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out);
}

.cookie-modal-overlay.visible .cookie-modal {
  transform: scale(1);
}

.cookie-modal h3 {
  font-size: var(--fs-h3);
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-4);
}

.cookie-modal p {
  font-size: var(--fs-small);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-5);
  line-height: 1.6;
}

.cookie-option {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  padding: var(--sp-3) 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
}

.cookie-option:last-child {
  border-bottom: none;
}

.cookie-option-label {
  font-size: var(--fs-small);
  font-weight: 500;
}

.cookie-option-label span {
  display: block;
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-weight: 400;
  margin-top: var(--sp-1);
}

/* Toggle Switch */
.toggle {
  position: relative;
  width: 44px;
  height: 24px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.toggle input {
  opacity: 0;
  width: 0;
  height: 0;
}

.toggle-slider {
  position: absolute;
  cursor: pointer;
  inset: 0;
  background: oklch(32% 0.01 265);
  border-radius: 12px;
  transition: background var(--duration-fast);
}

.toggle-slider::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  height: 18px;
  width: 18px;
  left: 3px;
  bottom: 3px;
  background: var(--text-primary);
  border-radius: 50%;
  transition: transform var(--duration-fast);
}

.toggle input:checked + .toggle-slider {
  background: var(--accent-blue);
}

.toggle input:checked + .toggle-slider::before {
  transform: translateX(20px);
}

.toggle input:disabled + .toggle-slider {
  opacity: 0.5;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}

.cookie-modal-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--sp-3);
  margin-top: var(--sp-5);
}

<script>
(function() {
  'use strict';

  // ============================================
  // TEAM DATA
  // ============================================
  const teamData = {
    'north-america': [
      {
        name: 'Denice Alvarez',
        title: 'Office Manager',
        office: 'New York',
        initials: 'DA',
        quote: 'As the Office Manager, I engage with teams from every discipline, and have learned so much through my day-to-day interactions with my fellow leapers.'
      },
      {
        name: 'Marco Bellini',
        title: 'Design Director',
        office: 'San Francisco',
        initials: 'MB',
        quote: 'Every day we are delighted by the immense beauty that nature holds. When engaged in the act of creation, it is our responsibility to channel that delight into the things we make.'
      }
    ],
    'asia': [
      {
        name: 'Priya Mehta',
        title: 'Studio Head',
        office: 'Bangalore',
        initials: 'PM',
        quote: 'We bring your brand vision to life, with transformative ideas and impactful marketing campaigns fueled by creativity and enthusiasm.'
      },
      {
        name: 'Thierry Lam',
        title: 'Design Lead',
        office: 'Singapore',
        initials: 'TL',
        quote: 'Good design is multifaceted. It impacts functionality, aesthetics, strategy, environment, business and so much more. Great design is seamless.'
      }
    ],
    'europe': [
      {
        name: 'Gavin Hartley',
        title: 'Managing Director',
        office: 'London',
        initials: 'GH',
        quote: "It's my job to make sure we innovate and push the boundaries when collaborating with brands to create inspiring customer experiences that deliver great business results."
      },
      {
        name: 'Francesca Terzi',
        title: 'Design Director',
        office: 'Munich',
        initials: 'FT',
        quote: 'At Leap Studio, I am constantly amazed by the talent I am surrounded with. We love to dream big and bring those dreams to life.'
      }
    ],
    'oceania': [
      {
        name: 'Jacintha Soo Ho',
        title: 'Senior Manager, CX Transformation',
        office: 'Melbourne',
        initials: 'JS',
        quote: 'I love helping clients see beyond their assumptions and showing them opportunities they haven\'t thought of before.'
      }
    ]
  };

  let currentRegion = 'north-america';
  let teamOffset = 0;

  // ============================================
  // HERO CAROUSEL
  // ============================================
  const heroTrack = document.getElementById('heroTrack');
  const heroDots = document.querySelectorAll('.hero-dot');
  const heroPrev = document.getElementById('heroPrev');
  const heroNext = document.getElementById('heroNext');
  const totalSlides = 5;
  let currentSlide = 0;
  let heroAutoplay;

  function goToSlide(index) {
    currentSlide = ((index % totalSlides) + totalSlides) % totalSlides;
    heroTrack.style.transform = `translateX(-${currentSlide * 100}%)`;
    heroDots.forEach((dot, i) => {
      dot.classList.toggle('active', i === currentSlide);
    });
  }

  function startHeroAutoplay() {
    stopHeroAutoplay();
    heroAutoplay = setInterval(() => goToSlide(currentSlide + 1), 6000);
  }

  function stopHeroAutoplay() {
    if (heroAutoplay) clearInterval(heroAutoplay);
  }

  heroDots.forEach(dot => {
    dot.addEventListener('click', () => {
      goToSlide(parseInt(dot.dataset.slide));
      startHeroAutoplay();
    });
  });

  heroPrev.addEventListener('click', () => { goToSlide(currentSlide - 1); startHeroAutoplay(); });
  heroNext.addEventListener('click', () => { goToSlide(currentSlide + 1); startHeroAutoplay(); });

  // Touch support for hero
  let heroTouchStartX = 0;
  const heroEl = document.getElementById('hero');
  heroEl.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => { heroTouchStartX = e.touches[0].clientX; }, { passive: true });
  heroEl.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
    const diff = heroTouchStartX - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
    if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) {
      goToSlide(diff > 0 ? currentSlide + 1 : currentSlide - 1);
      startHeroAutoplay();
    }
  }, { passive: true });

  startHeroAutoplay();

  // ============================================
  // TEAM CAROUSEL
  // ============================================
  const teamCarousel = document.getElementById('teamCarousel');
  const teamPrevBtn = document.getElementById('teamPrev');
  const teamNextBtn = document.getElementById('teamNext');
  const regionTabs = document.querySelectorAll('.region-tab');

  function renderTeamCards(region) {
    const members = teamData[region] || [];
    teamCarousel.innerHTML = members.map(m => `
      <div class="team-card">
        <div class="team-card-photo">
          <div class="team-card-photo-placeholder">${m.initials}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="team-card-body">
          <div class="team-card-name">${m.name}</div>
          <div class="team-card-title">${m.title}</div>
          <div class="team-card-quote">${m.quote}</div>
          <a href="#" class="team-card-cta">
            Contact Leap Studio ${m.office}
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M5 12h14M12 5l7 7-7 7"/></svg>
          </a>
        </div>
      </div>
    `).join('');
    teamOffset = 0;
    teamCarousel.style.transform = 'translateX(0)';
    updateTeamNav();
  }

  function updateTeamNav() {
    const members = teamData[currentRegion] || [];
    const cardWidth = 340 + 32; // min-width + gap
    const visibleWidth = teamCarousel.parentElement.offsetWidth;
    const totalWidth = members.length * cardWidth;
    const maxOffset = Math.max(0, totalWidth - visibleWidth);
    teamPrevBtn.disabled = teamOffset <= 0;
    teamNextBtn.disabled = teamOffset >= maxOffset;
  }

  function scrollTeam(direction) {
    const cardWidth = 340 + 32;
    const visibleWidth = teamCarousel.parentElement.offsetWidth;
    const members = teamData[currentRegion] || [];
    const totalWidth = members.length * cardWidth;
    const maxOffset = Math.max(0, totalWidth - visibleWidth);
    const step = Math.min(cardWidth, visibleWidth);

    teamOffset = Math.max(0, Math.min(maxOffset, teamOffset + direction * step));
    teamCarousel.style.transform = `translateX(-${teamOffset}px)`;
    updateTeamNav();
  }

  regionTabs.forEach(tab => {
    tab.addEventListener('click', () => {
      regionTabs.forEach(t => { t.classList.remove('active'); t.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'false'); });
      tab.classList.add('active');
      tab.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');
      currentRegion = tab.dataset.region;
      renderTeamCards(currentRegion);
    });
  });

  teamPrevBtn.addEventListener('click', () => scrollTeam(-1));
  teamNextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => scrollTeam(1));

  // Touch support for team carousel
  let teamTouchStartX = 0;
  teamCarousel.parentElement.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
    teamTouchStartX = e.touches[0].clientX;
  }, { passive: true });
  teamCarousel.parentElement.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
    const diff = teamTouchStartX - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
    if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) scrollTeam(diff > 0 ? 1 : -1);
  }, { passive: true });

  // Initialize
  renderTeamCards(currentRegion);
  window.addEventListener('resize', () => updateTeamNav());

  // ============================================
  // LANGUAGE SELECTOR
  // ============================================
  const langSelector = document.getElementById('langSelector');
  const langToggle = document.getElementById('langToggle');
  const langOptions = document.querySelectorAll('.lang-option');

  langToggle.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    const isOpen = langSelector.classList.toggle('open');
    langToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', isOpen);
  });

  langOptions.forEach(opt => {
    opt.addEventListener('click', () => {
      langOptions.forEach(o => { o.classList.remove('active'); o.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'false'); });
      opt.classList.add('active');
      opt.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');
      langToggle.innerHTML = `
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><path d="M2 12h20M12 2a15.3 15.3 0 0 1 4 10 15.3 15.3 0 0 1-4 10 15.3 15.3 0 0 1-4-10 15.3 15.3 0 0 1 4-10z"/></svg>
        ${opt.textContent}
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><polyline points="6 9 12 15 18 9"/></svg>
      `;
      langSelector.classList.remove('open');
      langToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    });
  });

  document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    if (!langSelector.contains(e.target)) {
      langSelector.classList.remove('open');
      langToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    }
  });

  // ============================================
  // MOBILE NAV
  // ============================================
  const navHamburger = document.getElementById('navHamburger');
  const mobileNav = document.getElementById('mobileNav');

  navHamburger.addEventListener('click', () => {
    navHamburger.classList.toggle('active');
    mobileNav.classList.toggle('open');
    document.body.style.overflow = mobileNav.classList.contains('open') ? 'hidden' : '';
  });

  document.querySelectorAll('.mobile-nav-link').forEach(link => {
    link.addEventListener('click', () => {
      navHamburger.classList.remove('active');
      mobileNav.classList.remove('open');
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    });
  });

  // ============================================
  // COOKIE CONSENT
  // ============================================
  const cookieBanner = document.getElementById('cookieBanner');
  const cookieModal = document.getElementById('cookieModal');
  const cookieAccept = document.getElementById('cookieAccept');
  const cookieDecline = document.getElementById('cookieDecline');
  const cookieManage = document.getElementById('cookieManage');
  const cookieModalAccept = document.getElementById('cookieModalAccept');
  const cookieModalDecline = document.getElementById('cookieModalDecline');
  const cookieSettingsBtn = document.getElementById('cookieSettingsBtn');
  const cookieSettingsLink = document.getElementById('cookieSettingsLink');

  // Show banner on load if no consent stored
  if (!localStorage.getItem('cookie-consent')) {
    setTimeout(() => cookieBanner.classList.add('visible'), 1000);
  }

  function hideBanner() {
    cookieBanner.classList.remove('visible');
  }

  cookieAccept.addEventListener('click', () => {
    localStorage.setItem('cookie-consent', 'accepted');
    hideBanner();
  });

  cookieDecline.addEventListener('click', () => {
    localStorage.setItem('cookie-consent', 'declined');
    hideBanner();
  });

  cookieManage.addEventListener('click', () => {
    cookieModal.classList.add('visible');
  });

  cookieModalAccept.addEventListener('click', () => {
    localStorage.setItem('cookie-consent', 'custom');
    cookieModal.classList.remove('visible');
    hideBanner();
  });

  cookieModalDecline.addEventListener('click', () => {
    localStorage.setItem('cookie-consent', 'declined');
    document.getElementById('cookiePerformance').checked = false;
    document.getElementById('cookieFunctional').checked = false;
    document.getElementById('cookieTargeting').checked = false;
    cookieModal.classList.remove('visible');
    hideBanner();
  });

  function openCookieSettings(e) {
    if (e) e.preventDefault();
    cookieModal.classList.add('visible');
  }

  if (cookieSettingsBtn) cookieSettingsBtn.addEventListener('click', openCookieSettings);
  if (cookieSettingsLink) cookieSettingsLink.addEventListener('click', openCookieSettings);

  cookieModal.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    if (e.target === cookieModal) cookieModal.classList.remove('visible');
  });

  // ============================================
  // SMOOTH SCROLL FOR NAV LINKS
  // ============================================
  document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(anchor => {
    anchor.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      const target = document.querySelector(this.getAttribute('href'));
      if (target) {
        e.preventDefault();
        target.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
      }
    });
  });

  // ============================================
  // NAV SCROLL EFFECT
  // ============================================
  const nav = document.getElementById('nav');
  let lastScroll = 0;
  window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
    const scroll = window.scrollY;
    if (scroll > 100) {
      nav.style.borderBottomColor = 'oklch(24% 0.01 265 / 0.8)';
    } else {
      nav.style.borderBottomColor = 'oklch(24% 0.01 265 / 0.5)';
    }
    lastScroll = scroll;
  }, { passive: true });

})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

2. **Team Carousel** — 4 region tabs (North America, Asia, Europe, Oceania) filtering 7 team members with photos, quotes, titles, and contact CTAs
3. **Work Showcase** — Horizontal-scrolling project cards for 8 case studies (Unilever, IKEA, Volvo, Chase, Tiffany & Co., Carrefour, + 2 additional)
4. **CTA Banner** — "Let's work together" with gradient glow effects
5. **How We Work** — Two-column layout with visual + "Advancing people and planet" content
6. **Latest Insights** — Responsive grid of 8 insight cards (podcasts, articles, reports) with type indicators
7. **Principles** — 4 principle cards with numbered indicators and hover effects
8. **Footer** — Dual CTA cards, nav links, legal links

**6 Interactive Features:**
- Hero carousel with auto-play, dots, arrows, and touch swipe
- Region-toggle team carousel with left/right navigation
- Horizontal-scrolling work showcase
- Language selector dropdown (Global EN / France FR / China CN)
- Cookie consent banner with Accept/Decline/Manage options
- Cookie settings modal with toggle switches

**Responsive:** Mobile hamburger nav, adaptive carousels, and responsive grid breakpoints at 640px and 1024px. Touch-friendly with 44px+ targets.
